description: EVOTEC IS POISED TO START, UNDER CARB-X FUNDING, A NEW PROGRAM. THIS PROGRAM IS AT LEAD-TO-CANDIDATE STAGE AND AIMS AT DELIVERING AN IV-ADMINISTERED BROAD-SPECTRUM ANTIBACTERIAL DRUG CANDIDATE TO ADDRESS SEVERE HOSPITAL INFECTIONS CAUSED BY MULTI-DRUG RESISTANT (MDR) PATHOGENS. THE CORRESPONDING COMPOUNDS CONSTITUTE A NEW ANTIBACTERIAL CLASS THAT SIMULTANEOUSLY TARGETS TWO ESSENTIAL, WELL VALIDATED BACTERIAL ENZYMES. HOWEVER, THEY ACT BY A NEW MODE OF ACTION BECAUSE THEY BIND TO SITES THAT ARE NOT TARGETED BY CURRENTLY MARKETED ANTIBACTERIALS. THIS CLASS HAS SEVERAL BENEFICIAL PROPERTIES, INCLUDING A VERY BROAD-SPECTRUM OF BOTH GRAM-POSITIVE AND GRAM-NEGATIVE PATHOGENS, COVERING IN PARTICULAR MOST OF THE PROBLEMATIC MDR STRAINS. IN ADDITION, THE CLASS IS NOTED FOR ITS HIGH ANTIBACTERIAL POTENCY AND VERY LOW PROPENSITY TO SELECT RESISTANT STRAINS DUE TO THE UNIQUE DUAL-TARGETING MECHANISM. THE LEAD COMPOUNDS HAVE PERFORMED WELL IN EFFICACY AND SAFETY STUDIES. THE GOAL OF THE EVOTEC, CARB-X FUNDED PROGRAM IS TO COMPLETE THE OPTIMIZATION OF THE SERIES, IDENTIFY PRE-CANDIDATES AND ADVANCE THE MOST PROMISING COMPOUND INTO CLINICAL STUDIES. OVERALL, THIS NEW PROGRAM HAS POTENTIAL TO DELIVER TO THE CLINIC A NOVEL MODE OF ACTION, BROAD-SPECTRUM ANTIBACTERIAL DRUG, A MAJOR EVENT IN THE FIELD SINCE DECADES.

description: CELLULAR IMMUNITY, LARGELY REGULATED BY CD4+ T CELLS, IS REQUIRED IN CONTROL OF INFECTION WITH THE PATHOGENIC FUNGUS BLASTOMYCES DERMATITIDIS. DERMATITIDIS. IMMUNE RESPONSES IN THE MICE AND IN HUMANS WILL BE MEASURED BY STANDARD ASSAYS FOR CYTOKINE AND CELLULAR RESPONSE. DERMATITIDIS AND DEPOSITED INFORMATION ABOUT THESE PEPTIDE SEQUENCES INTO THE IMMUNE EPITOPE DATABASE (IEDB.ORG).

description: STATEMENT OF WORK PROJECT TITLE: A MULTIDISCIPLINARY APPROACH TO UNDERSTANDING STIMULANT USE DISORDERS: USE TRAJECTORIES, MEDICAL CONSEQUENCES AND TREATMENT GOALS PRIMARY SITE PI: DANIEL CICCARONE, MD, MPH PRIMARY SITE INSTITUTION: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA SAN FRANCISCO SUBAWARD SITE PI: ALLISON SCHLOSSER, PHD, MSW SUBAWARD SITE INSTITUTION: UNIVERSITY OF NEBRASKA OMAHA PROJECT START/END DATE: 01/01/2022 Ã¢Â‚¬Â€Œ 08/31/2023 PROJECT DESCRIPTION: OVER THE LAST DECADE MORTALITY DUE TO OPIOIDS, AND NOW PSYCHOSTIMULANTS, HAS CLIMBED DRAMATICALLY. THE REPLACEMENT OF HEROIN WITH NOVEL SYNTHETICS SUCH AS FENTANYLS, THE RESURGENCE OF METHAMPHETAMINE, AND THE PROLIFERATION OF COUNTERFEIT PILLS HAVE CREATED A SITUATION OF NEW COMPLEXITY AND UNKNOWN RISKS WITH AN URGENT NEED FOR KNOWLEDGE. LITTLE IS KNOWN ABOUT THE TRAJECTORIES OF PERSONS WITH STIMULANT USE DISORDERS. THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS STUDY IS TO GAIN GREATER UNDERSTANDING OF THE TRAJECTORIES TOWARD STIMULANT USE DISORDER BY USING ETHNOGRAPHIC/QUALITATIVE METHODOLOGIES (I.E., IN-DEPTH INTERVIEWS AND OBSERVATIONS) AMONG PEOPLE WHO USE LICIT AND ILLICIT STIMULANTS. IT WILL EXPLORE THE TRAJECTORIES FROM LICIT TO ILLICIT STIMULANT USE AND TO STIMULANT USE DISORDERS AS WELL AS TREATMENT SEEKING GOALS AND MOTIVATIONS. QUALITATIVE RESEARCH WILL BE PERFORMED IN THREE SITES OVER TWO YEARS: 1) SENTINEL SITE OF SAN FRANCISCO, CA 2) COMPARATIVE SITE OF WEST VIRGINIA 3) COMPARATIVE SITE OF NEBRASKA MAJOR GOALS/MILESTONES BY PROJECT YEAR: Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ YEAR 1: 30 QUALITATIVE INTERVIEWS AND 10 OBSERVATIONS; STEADY STREET PRESENCE THROUGH ETHNOGRAPHY Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ YEAR 2: ADDITIONAL QUALITATIVE INTERVIEWS/OBSERVATIONS (30 INTERVIEWS + 5 OBSERVATIONS); CONTINUED STREET ETHNOGRAPHY; CONTINUED QUALITATIVE ANALYSES; MANUSCRIPT PREPARATION DR. SCHLOSSER, THE STUDY CO-INVESTIGATOR AND LEAD QUALITATIVE DATA ANALYST, WILL TRAVEL TO SAN FRANCISCO, CA IN YEAR 1 AND IN YEAR 2 TO OVERSEE QUALITATIVE DATA COLLECTION AT THIS SITE (EACH TRIP WILL LAST APPROXIMATELY ONE WEEK). NO ADDITIONAL PERSONNEL, SUPPLIES, OR EQUIPMENT IS NEEDED TO PERFORM THIS WORK. PROJECT DELIVERABLES INCLUDE: -MONTHLY PROGRESS REPORTS -COMPLETION OF YEAR 1 INTERVIEWS AND OBSERVATIONS (N=30) -COMPLETION OF YEAR 2 INTERVIEWS AND OBSERVATIONS (N=30) -PUBLICATION OF ONE INTERVIEW DATA PAPER -PUBLICATION OF ONE SITE COMPARATIVE PAPER THE SUBAWARDEE, DR. SCHLOSSER, WILL CONTRIBUTE HER EXPERTISE IN QUALITATIVE AND ETHNOGRAPHIC RESEARCH ON DRUG USE TO THIS PROJECT. SHE HAS CONDUCTED RESEARCH ON DRUG USE AND THE PREVENTION AND TREATMENT OF SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS FOR THE LAST 15 YEARS, USING ETHNOGRAPHIC AND OTHER QUALITATIVE RESEARCH METHODS TO EXAMINE DRUG USE OUTSIDE OF INSTITUTIONAL SETTINGS, RESIDENTIAL TREATMENT, COMMUNITY-LED PREVENTION EFFORTS, AND HARM REDUCTION SERVICES.

description: THERE IS AN URGENT UNMET NEED FOR RAPID, POINT OF CARE SOLUTIONS FOR STI IDENTIFICATION IN FRONTLINE, RESOURCE-LIMITED SETTINGS. CONCURRENTLY, THERE IS A SHIFT TO ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE GUIDED THERAPY FOR PATIENT MANAGEMENT, ENSURING TREATMENT WITH THE MOST APPROPRIATE ANTIBIOTIC TO IMPROVE PATIENT OUTCOMES WHILST RESERVING ANTIBIOTICS FOR WHERE THEY ARE NEEDED. CURRENT ANTIBIOTIC SUSCEPTIBILITY TESTING METHODS FAIL TO OFFER AFFORDABLE, TIMELY AND COMPREHENSIVE SUSCEPTIBILITY/RESISTANCE INFORMATION, ESPECIALLY IN RESOURCE-LIMITED SETTINGS. SPEEDX AIMS TO DEVELOP AN AFFORDABLE, FAST (<60 MINS), POINT-OF-CARE TEST FOR THE DETECTION OF CHLAMYDIA TRACHOMATIS (CT) AND NEISSERIA GONORRHEA (NG), AND, IN ADDITION, DETERMINING THE SUSCEPTIBILITY OF NG TO THREE CHEAP, ORALLY ADMINISTERED ACCESSIBLE, ANTIBIOTICS: CEFIXIME, CIPROFLOXACIN, AND AZITHROMYCIN. SPEEDX HAVE DEVELOPED A CULTURE-FREE, MOLECULAR SOLUTION TERMED INSIGNIAÃ¢Â€ŽÂ¢. INSIGNIA DETERMINES THE VIABILITY OF ORGANISM IN A SAMPLE AND THE MOLECULAR RESPONSE OF A VIABLE ORGANISM TO ANTIBIOTICS BY MEASURING APPROPRIATE DNA TRANSCRIPTION ACTIVITY. THE MEASURED CHANGE IN DNA TRANSCRIPTION ACTIVITY WILL BE USED TO INDICATE WHETHER THE ORGANISM IN THE INFECTION IS LIKELY TO RESPOND TO THE CHOSEN ANTIBIOTIC. THE FUNDED STUDY WILL FOCUS ON THE DEVELOPMENT OF A PROTOTYPE OF A CT-NG TEST UTILIZING INSIGNIA TECHNOLOGY ON THE QUANTUMDX Q-POC POINT OF CARE DEVICE. THIS DEVICE IS A PORTABLE, BATTERY OPERABLE, SAMPLE TO ANSWER DEVICE THAT CAN BE USED EVEN IN REMOTE SETTINGS, INCREASING ACCESS TO QUALITY DIAGNOSTICS FOR IMPROVED PATIENT CARE IN AREAS WHERE IT IS REALLY NEEDED.

THE SEM-EDX METHODOLOGY WILL GENERALLY FOLLOW OUR PREVIOUS METHODS AS DESCRIBED BY SARVER ET AL. (2021) OPTION PHASE OUR TEAM WILL PARTICIPATE IN IDENTIFICATION OF POSSIBLE MINE PARTNERS FOR COLLECTION OF REAL CPDM SAMPLES (TASK E), AND CONTINGENT ON PARTNER REQUIREMENTS WE MAY PARTICIPATE IN THE SAMPLE COLLECTION EFFORTS. description: ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE IS A GROWING PUBLIC HEALTH CONCERN WORSENED BY THE LACK OF EFFECTIVE ANTIMICROBIAL THERAPIES TO TREAT INFECTIONS WITH MULTIDRUG-RESISTANT ORGANISMS (MDRO). OF THESE, CARBAPENEM-RESISTANT ENTEROBACTERIACEAE (CRE), EXTENDED-SPECTRUM BETA LACTAMASE PRODUCERS (ESBL), AND VANCOMYCIN-RESISTANT ENTEROCOCCI (VRE) ARE BECOMING INCREASINGLY PREVALENT IN HOSPITALS WORLDWIDE AND ARE EXTREMELY CHALLENGING TO TREAT. INFECTIONS WITH THESE ORGANISMS CAN RESULT IN LIFE-THREATENING TREATMENT DELAYS OR DEATH AND RESULT IN APPROXIMATELY $2 BILLION HEALTHCARE-ASSOCIATED COSTS DUE TO PATIENT ISOLATION PRACTICES ALONE. CURRENT TREATMENT OPTIONS RELY ON ANTIBIOTICS THAT ARE TOXIC, LIMITED IN SPECTRUM AND FOR WHICH RESISTANCE HAS ALREADY EMERGED. BECAUSE OF THIS, NOVEL STRATEGIES TO TARGET INFECTIONS WITH THESE ORGANISMS AND CURB THE EMERGENCE OF ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE ARE URGENTLY NEEDED. INTESTINAL MDRO COLONIZATION HAS BEEN SHOWN TO PRECEDE INFECTION IN HIGHLY SUSCEPTIBLE PATIENT POPULATIONS AND IT IS ASSOCIATED WITH POOR OUTCOME. DECOLONIZATION STRATEGIES SUCH AS FECAL MICROBIOTA TRANSPLANTATION (FMT) HAVE BEEN SUCCESSFUL IN ELIMINATING THE INTESTINAL MDRO RESERVOIR, RESULTING IN SIGNIFICANTLY LOWER MDRO INFECTION RATES. THEREFORE, DECOLONIZATION OF HIGHLY ANTIBIOTIC-RESISTANT BACTERIA USING MICROBIOME-BASED APPROACHES OFFERS A NOVEL AND PROMISING ALTERNATIVE TO CURRENT INFECTION THERAPIES. VEDANTA BIOSCIENCES IS A CLINICAL-STAGE MICROBIOME COMPANY PIONEERING THE DEVELOPMENT OF LIVE BIOTHERAPEUTIC PRODUCTS (LBPS) CONSISTING OF PRECISELY-DEFINED AND WELL-CHARACTERIZED BACTERIAL CONSORTIA FOR THE TREATMENT OF INFLAMMATORY AND INFECTIOUS DISEASES. VEDANTA IS ADDRESSING THE CRITICAL NEED FOR NOVEL THERAPEUTICS TO PREVENT MDRO INFECTION BY DEVELOPING VE707, AN ORALLY ADMINISTERED INVESTIGATIONAL LBP CONSISTING OF DEFINED, WELL-CHARACTERIZED, BENEFICIAL GUT BACTERIA. VE707 IS PRODUCED FROM PURE, CLONAL BACTERIAL CELL BANKS, WHICH YIELD A PRODUCT OF UNIFORM COMPOSITION AND FREE OF ANY PATHOGENIC STRAINS, BYPASSING THE NEED TO RELY ON FECAL DONOR MATERIAL WITH INCONSISTENT COMPOSITION. VE707 IS DESIGNED TO DECOLONIZE GUT-DWELLING MDROS IN PATIENTS AT HIGH RISK FOR DEVELOPING INFECTIONS. SPECIFICALLY, VE707 IS BEING DEVELOPED TO ELIMINATE INTESTINAL CARRIAGE OF CRE, ESBL AND VRE TO PREVENT INFECTIONS WITH THESE ORGANISMS, RESTORE A HEALTHY MICROBIOTA, AS WELL AS PREVENT COLONIZATION RECURRENCE.

description: HOSPITAL-ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA CAUSED BY THE BACTERIAL PATHOGEN STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS IS ASSOCIATED WITH PATIENT MORBIDITY AND MORTALITY, IN SPITE OF ADEQUATE ANTIBIOTIC THERAPY. AN IMPORTANT PATHOGENICITY FACTOR AND PRECLINICALLY VALIDATED TARGET IS Α-HEMOLYSIN (HLA), A PORE-FORMING TOXIN SECRETED BY THE BACTERIA DURING ESTABLISHMENT OF THE INFECTION. A-HEMOLYSIN AFFECTS IMMUNE CELL, ENDOTHELIAL CELL AND PNEUMOCYTE INTEGRITY THUS CONTRIBUTING TO DISEASE FROM MULTIPLE DIRECTIONS. THE HELMHOLTZ CENTRE FOR INFECTION RESEARCH AND THE LEAD DISCOVERY CENTER OF MAX PLANCK HAVE DISCOVERED A HIGHLY POTENT SERIES OF FIRST-IN-CLASS SMALL MOLECULE INHIBITORS OF HLA.

description: PATTERN IS DEVELOPING A SINGLE CELL ANALYSIS PLATFORM THAT ENABLES FAST, TARGETED ANTIBIOTIC TREATMENT BY DELIVERING RAPID PATHOGEN IDENTIFICATION (ID) AND PHENOTYPIC ANTIMICROBIAL SUSCEPTIBILITY TEST (AST) RESULTS. WE ACCOMPLISH ID AND AST USING A NOVEL METHOD THAT REDUCES SYSTEM COMPLEXITY, ENABLES COST-EFFECTIVE TESTING, AND PERMITS TESTING DIRECTLY FROM CHALLENGING NON-STERILE SPECIMENS. THE PATTERN PLATFORM UTILIZES PHENOTYPIC SUSCEPTIBILITY TESTING METHODS, ENSURING THE CLINICAL VALIDITY OF CURRENT GOLD STANDARD AST METHODS IS MAINTAINED FOR RAPID TESTING. CONVENTIONAL ANTIBIOTIC SUSCEPTIBILITY TESTING TIMES OFTEN EXCEED 48 HOURS, WHICH LEAVES CLINICIANS WITH INCOMPLETE INFORMATION TO PROVIDE DEFINITIVE TREATMENT. AS A RESULT, CLINICIANS MUST TREAT EMPIRICALLY. WHEN CHOOSING AN EMPIRIC ANTIMICROBIAL REGIMEN, THE CLINICIAN MUST BALANCE THE RISK OF POOR PATIENT OUTCOME (FROM POTENTIALLY UNDER-TREATING A DRUG-RESISTANT PATHOGEN) AGAINST THE SOCIETAL VALUE OF ANTIMICROBIAL STEWARDSHIP. RAPID ID/AST CAN DRAMATICALLY SHORTEN THE EMPIRIC TREATMENT TIME WINDOW, ENABLING EARLIER THERAPEUTIC OPTIMIZATION THAT WILL IMPROVE PATIENT OUTCOMES AND HELP PRESERVE THE EFFICACY OF OUR MOST POTENT ANTIBIOTICS.

description: INFECTIONS CAUSED BY MULTIDRUG-RESISTANT BACTERIA HAVE BECOME ONE OF THE MOST IMPORTANT THREATS TO GLOBAL HEALTH TODAY, RESULTING IN AN ESTIMATED 700,000 DEATHS ANNUALLY. GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA ARE OF PARTICULAR CONCERN, BECAUSE OF THEIR INTRINSIC RESISTANCE, RAPID ACQUISITION AND SPREAD OF NEW RESISTANCE, AND THE PAUCITY OF NOVEL ANTIBIOTIC DEVELOPMENT TARGETING THESE BACTERIA IN THE LAST DECADE. THE CENTERS FOR DISEASE CONTROL AND PREVENTION AND THE WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION IDENTIFIED CARBAPENEM-RESISTANT ENTEROBACTERIACEAE, CARBAPENEM-RESISTANT ACINETOBACTER BAUMANNII AND MULTIDRUG-RESISTANT (MDR) PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA AS HIGH PRIORITY PATHOGENS FOR WHICH NEW AND EFFECTIVE ANTIBIOTIC TREATMENTS ARE URGENTLY NEEDED. THE CDC CLASSIFIES THE FIRST TWO GROUPS AS URGENT THREATS THAT ARE IMMINENT AND REQUIRE URGENT AND AGGRESSIVE ACTION, AND MDR P. AERUGINOSA INFECTIONS AS A SERIOUS THREAT THAT REQUIRES PROMPT AND SUSTAINED ACTION. THE PROGRAM AIMS TO DISCOVER AND DEVELOP POTENT, SELECTIVE INHIBITORS OF 1-DEOXY-D-XYLULOSE 5-PHOSPHATE REDUCTOISOMERASE (DXR) FOR THE TREATMENT OF INFECTIONS CAUSED BY DRUG-RESISTANT GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA. DXR CATALYZES THE FIRST COMMITTED STEP IN THE D-ERYTHRITOL 4-PHOSPHATE PATHWAY FOR ISOPRENOID SYNTHESIS, WHICH IS ESSENTIAL FOR GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA. DXR IS NOT TARGETED BY CURRENTLY AVAILABLE ANTIBIOTICS AND, SINCE MAMMALS UTILIZE A DIFFERENT PATHWAY FOR ISOPRENOID SYNTHESIS, IT IS A VERY ATTRACTIVE TARGET FOR NOVEL ANTIBIOTICS. THE DXR ENZYME IS ESSENTIAL FOR SURVIVAL OF MANY BACTERIAL PATHOGENS INCLUDING THOSE IDENTIFIED BY THE CDC AND WHO AS HIGH PRIORITY PATHOGENS CAUSATIVE OF THE MOST THREATENING INFECTIONS. THE PROGRAM IS CURRENTLY AT HIT-TO-LEAD RESEARCH STAGE. HITS HAVE BEEN IDENTIFIED THAT POTENTLY INHIBIT THE DXR ENZYME AND SHOW ANTIBACTERIAL ACTIVITY AGAINST SELECTED BACTERIA. THE ONGOING MEDICINAL CHEMISTRY PROGRAM FOCUSSES ON IMPROVING ENZYME INHIBITION, ANTIBACTERIAL ACTIVITY AND PHARMACOLOGICAL PROPERTIES OF THE CURRENT HIT COMPOUNDS AS WELL AS ENSURING LOW RESISTANCE DEVELOPMENT . TO THIS END, WE ARE SYSTEMATICALLY DETERMINING KEY PARAMETERS TO BUILD THE STRUCTURE-ACTIVITY-RELATIONSHIP SUPPORTING FURTHER IMPROVEMENT OF THE CURRENT HIT COMPOUNDS. WE ALSO MAKE USE OF RECENTLY OBTAINED INSIGHTS FROM X-RAY CRYSTALLOGRAPHY OF COMPLEXES BETWEEN THE TARGET ENZYME AND HIT COMPOUNDS. THE GOAL OF THIS PROGRAM IS THE IDENTIFICATION OF LEADS WITH POTENT BROAD-SPECTRUM ANTIBACTERIAL ACTIVITY, INCLUDING AGAINST HIGH-PRIORITY PATHOGENS, LOW RESISTANCE DEVELOPMENT POTENTIAL AND APPROPRIATE PHARMACOLOGICAL PROPERTIES. THESE LEADS CAN THEN BE FURTHER OPTIMIZED TOWARDS A CLINICAL CANDIDATE READY TO START IND-ENABLING STUDIES. THE ULTIMATE GOAL IS TO DEVELOP A SAFE AND EFFECTIVE NOVEL TREATMENT OPTION FOR SERIOUS INFECTIONS INCLUDING NOSOCOMIAL RESPIRATORY TRACT INFECTIONS. HOSPITAL-ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA IS THE LEADING CAUSE OF DEATH FROM NOSOCOMIAL INFECTIONS IN CRITICALLY ILL PATIENTS, WITH AN ESTIMATED ALL-CAUSE MORTALITY OF 20-30% OR EVEN 20-50% IN CASES OF VENTILATOR-ASSOCIATED PNEUMONIA. GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA SUCH AS MEMBERS OF THE ENTEROBACTERIACEAE AND GRAM-NEGATIVE NON-FERMENTERS (E.G. P. AERUGINOSA AND A. BAUMANNII) ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR MOST CASES OF BACTERIAL HOSPITAL- AND VENTILATOR-ASSOCIATED PNEUMONIA. OTHER SERIOUS BACTERIAL INFECTIONS SUCH AS COMPLICATED INTRA-ABDOMINAL INFECTIONS AND COMPLICATED URINARY TRACT INFECTIONS INCLUDING PYELONEPHRITIS, ALSO PREDOMINANTLY CAUSED BY GRAM-NEGATIVE PATHOGENS, MAY REPRESENT FURTHER TARGET INDICATIONS OF THIS PROGRAM.

description: THE TTIMS LRCC FUNCTIONS ARE TO SERVE AS THE BIOSTATISTICAL AND ANALYTICAL CENTER FOR ANALYSES RELEVANT TO THE EVALUATION AND MONITORING OF INFECTIONS INCLUDING THOSE IN HIV (INCIDENT AND PREVALENT), HCV (INCIDENT), HBV (INCIDENT) AND SYPHILIS (RECENT) TEST-POSITIVE BLOOD DONORS BY COLLECTING AND ANALYZING DATA FOR RISK FACTORS, MOLECULAR SURVEILLANCE AND ANTI- RETROVIRAL DRUG USE THAT MAY IMPACT THE DETECTION OF HIV. SPECIFICALLY, THE PRIMARY OBJECTIVES OF THIS CONTRACT ARE TO: Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ EVALUATE AND MONITOR RISK FACTOR CHARACTERISTICS OF DONATIONS CONFIRMED POSITIVE FOR TTIS AS STATED ABOVE, AND COMPARISON TO UNINFECTED US ALLOGENEIC BLOOD DONORS. Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ INTEGRATE RISK FACTOR DATA AND DISEASE MARKER SURVEILLANCE INFORMATION ACROSS DIFFERENT BLOOD COLLECTION ORGANIZATIONS. Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ MONITOR ARV AND PREP/PEP USE IN US ALLOGENEIC BLOOD DONOR POPULATION BASED ON TESTING OF BOTH HIV-POSITIVE AND INFECTION-NEGATIVE DONATIONS FOR THE PRESENCE OF ARV DRUGS. Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ EXPLORE THE CHARACTERISTICS OF BLOOD DONORS WHO USE ARV/PREP/PEP TO BETTER UNDERSTAND THEIR RISKS, KNOWLEDGE, AND MOTIVATIONS FOR DONATING WHILE USING THESE THERAPIES. Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ EVALUATE WELL-CHARACTERIZED US BLOOD DONOR SAMPLES FROM TTIMS AND OTHER SOURCES FOR THE REFINEMENT OF EXISTING ANALYTICAL METHODS SUCH AS THE SEDIA LAG AVIDITY ASSAY TO DERIVE ESTIMATES OF RECENT INFECTION WITH HIV WITH A GOAL OF RAPIDLY OBTAINING MORE ACCURATE AND TIMELY RESULTS. Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ PROVIDE LOGISTICAL SUPPORT FOR THE TTIMS PROJECT AND FOR THE COMMITTEE/SUBCOMMITTEE MEETINGS, CONFERENCES, AND DONATION(S) TRANSFER/SHIPMENT. IN SUPPORT OF THESE OBJECTIVES, ARC WILL RECRUIT, ENROLL AND INTERVIEW ELIGIBLE PARTICIPANTS, PROVIDE DATA AS REQUIRED IN THE TTIMS LRCC STATEMENT OF WORK, PROVIDE BIOSPECIMENS FOR RESEARCH TESTING AT VRI, AND WILL ACTIVELY COLLABORATE IN THE ANALYSIS, INTERPRETATION, AND REPORTING OF FINDINGS IN TTIMS. SUSAN STRAMER, PHD, WILL SERVE AS THE PRINCIPAL INVESTIGATOR (PI) AT ARC. SHE WILL OVERSEE ALL ASPECTS OF ARCÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S PARTICIPATION IN THE LRCC PORTION OF TTIMS INCLUDING ACQUISITION OF DONOR DATA AND BIOSPECIMENS AND WILL PARTICIPATE IN CALLS AND MEETINGS FOR THE TTIMS PROJECT. IN ADDITION, ROGER DODD, PHD, WILL SERVE AS THE CO-PRINCIPAL INVESTIGATOR AT ARC. HE WILL ASSIST IN THE OVERSIGHT OF THE ACQUISITION OF DONOR DATA AND WILL PARTICIPATE IN CALLS AND MEETINGS FOR THE TTIMS PROJECT WHEN NECESSARY. ARC WILL RECRUIT DONORS WITH QUALIFYING TEST RESULTS; ADMINISTER THE WEB-BASED QUESTIONNAIRE AND ENTER RISK FACTOR DATA INTO AN ELECTRONIC DATABASE; PERFORM QUALITY CONTROL (QC) ON ALL DATA ENTERED INTO THE DATABASE; RESPOND TO REQUESTS FROM THE LRCC REGARDING DATA QUALITY ASSURANCE AND QC; DEVELOP AND SUBMIT TO THE LOCAL IRB DOCUMENTS AND AMENDMENTS FOR APPROVAL. ARC STAFF WILL PROVIDE TO VRI 5 X 1 ML PLASMA CRYOVIALS AND A SINGLE 5 ML PLASMA CRYOVIAL FOR EACH PARTICIPANT. IN COLLABORATION WITH THE LRCC, ARC WILL COORDINATE SAMPLE SHIPMENT WITH DESIGNATED VRI STAFF. IN ADDITION, ARC WILL WORK WITH THE LRCC AND CTS TO SOURCE SPECIMENS FOR ARV/PEP/PREP TESTING. ARC WILL ALSO WORK THE LRCC TO FACILITATE SURVEYS AND QUALITATIVE INTERVIEWS OF ARV/PEP/PREP TEST-POSITIVE BLOOD DONORS. ARC WILL BE A COLLABORATOR IN THE COLLECTION OF THESE SURVEY AND QUALITATIVE INTERVIEW DATA AND WILL ASSIST IN IDENTIFYING AND RECRUITING PARTICIPANTS FOR THESE ACTIVITIES. ADDENDUMS TO THIS SOW WILL BE DEVELOPED AFTER THE RESEARCH PROTOCOLS TO SUPPORT EXPANDED ART/PEP/PREP STUDIES ARE FULLY DEFINED AND APPROVED BY THE TTIMS STEERING COMMITTEE.

description: THERE ARE SIGNIFICANT CHALLENGES TO THE CURRENTLY AVAILABLE DIAGNOSTIC TESTS FOR NEONATAL BACTEREMIA. THERE ARE AN ESTIMATED 19 MILLION CASES OF SEPSIS REPORTED EACH YEAR WORLDWIDE LEADING TO APPROXIMATELY ONE MILLION NEWBORN DEATHS GLOBALLY PER YEAR. A SEPSIS DIAGNOSTIC PLATFORM THAT RETURNS FASTER TIME-TO-RESULTS HAS THE POTENTIAL TO VASTLY IMPROVE PATIENT OUTCOMES AND ANTIBIOTIC STEWARDSHIP. IN THIS PROJECT, BAEBIES WILL BE INTEGRATING TRADITIONAL BLOOD CULTURE METHODS INTO FINDER, OUR NEAR-PATIENT DIGITAL MICROFLUIDIC ANALYZER. THE PROPOSED SYSTEM WILL HAVE CAPABILITY TO CONTINUOUSLY MONITOR CONTENTS FROM BLOOD CULTURE BOTTLES AND DETECT FOR PRESENCE OF BACTERIA, USING METHODS THAT ARE MORE SENSITIVE THAN TRADITIONAL O2/CO2 DETECTION. AFTER A BLOOD CULTURE POSITIVE CALL, BACTERIAL STRAIN IDENTIFICATION AND SUSCEPTIBILITY TESTING WILL THEN BE PERFORMED AUTOMATICALLY ON THE SAME CARTRIDGE WITHOUT NEED FOR ANY USER INTERVENTION. IN ADDITION TO BLOOD CULTURE, THE FINDER PLATFORM WILL ALSO BE ANALYZING UNIQUE GENE SIGNATURES FROM AS LITTLE AS 125UL OF WHOLE BLOOD TO ASSESS HOST RESPONSE PROFILES TO DISTINGUISH BETWEEN BACTERIAL VS. NON-BACTERIAL INFECTION. THIS SYSTEM WILL CATER SPECIFICALLY TO THE NEEDS OF NEONATAL AND PEDIATRIC POPULATIONS. THE BAEBIES MISSION IS TO SAVE LIVES AND MAKE LIVES BETTER FOR ALL CHILDREN BY BRINGING NEW TECHNOLOGIES, NEW TESTS, AND NEW HOPE TO PARENTS AND HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS WORLDWIDE. THE Ã¢Â‚¬Å“EÃ¢Â‚¬Ï¿½ IN BAEBIES DEMONSTRATES OUR COMMITMENT THAT EVERY CHILD DESERVES A HEALTHY START, AND WE BELIEVE THAT THIS PRODUCT WILL FULFILL OUR VISION.

description: PRECISION KILLING OF BACTERIA HAS THE IMPACT TO REVOLUTIONIZE THE MANAGEMENT OF UNTREATABLE AND DIFFICULT-TO-TREAT INFECTIONS INCLUDING ANTI-MICROBIAL RESISTANT STRAINS, AS WELL AS COMPLEX DISEASES DIRECTLY IMPACTED BY THE HUMAN MICROBIOTA. THE IMPORTANCE OF THE HUMAN MICROBIOME HAS BEEN INCREASINGLY RECOGNIZED IN DISEASE AND TREATMENT OUTCOMES. THE TECHNOLOGY CAN SELECTIVELY TARGET STRAINS OF CHOICE AND SPARE THE MICROBIOME. OUR MISSION IS TO DEVELOP CRISPR-BASED MEDICINES THAT GIVE HOPE FOR EFFECTIVE AND SAFE TREATMENT OF DIFFICULT-TO-TREAT DISEASES IN THE FUTURE. SNIPR BIOME IS PIONEERING A NOVEL USE OF CRISPR/CAS TECHNOLOGY TO SELECTIVELY ERADICATE TARGET BACTERIA, WHILE LEAVING THE REST OF THE PATIENT’S MICROBIAL COMMUNITY INTACT. WE ARE UTILIZING THE BACTERIA’S ADAPTIVE CRISPR-BASED IMMUNE SYSTEM IN A FULLY PROGRAMMABLE FASHION TO VERY SELECTIVELY KILL TARGET BACTERIA BASED ON SPECIFIC DNA SEQUENCE SIGNATURES IN THE BACTERIAL GENOME.

description: PROFESSOR DELIA GOLETTI WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE WHOLE ORGANIZATION OF THE STUDY, WRITING THE PROJECT FOR THE ETHICAL COMMITTEE, SUPERVISING THE EXPERIMENTAL WORK AND THE GENERATION OF THE RESULTS, REPORTING THE ENROLMENT RESULTS, ENROLLING THE OUTPATIENTS AND HEALTHY DONORS, REPORTING THE RESULTS FROM THE EXPERIMENTAL STUDY, DISCUSSING WITH THE PI OF THE PROJECT. REGARDING THE SCIENTIFIC HELP, THE SECOND BIOLOGIST WILL BE DEDICATED TO THE SCIENTIFIC LABORATORY AND WILL TAKE CARE OF THE SETTING UP OF THE EXPERIMENTAL PROCEDURES, COLLECTION OF THE SAMPLES, DATA ANALYSIS, STATISTICAL ANALYSIS, WRITING THE SCIENTIFIC REPORTS, PRESENT THE RESULTS AT THE SCIENTIFIC MEETINGS. WE WILL USE PART OF THE BUDGET TO TRAVEL IN THE SECOND AND THIRD YEAR OF INMIÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S INVOLVEMENT FOR GOING TO MEETINGS WITH THE PI OR TO ATTEND MEETINGS TO BE UPDATED WITH THE LITERATURE AND/OR PRESENT THE DATA GENERATED WITHIN THE PROJECT. WE WILL BUY THE FOLLOWING MATERIAL AND REAGENTS: PLASTICS FOR THE EXPERIMENTAL TESTS (I.E. PLATES, VIALS) AND REAGENTS (I.E. MEDIUM, ANTIBIOTICS, ANTIBODIES, ELISA KITS). THE SECOND YEAR WE WILL PROCESS AND EXECUTE THE MAJORITIES OF THE EXPERIMENTS FROM THE MAJORITIES OF THE PATIENTS ENROLLED. THIS IS THE MOTIVATION OF HAVING MORE ECONOMIC RESOURCES FOR THE SUPPLIES IN THE SECOND YEAR.

description: GROUP A STREPTOCOCCUS OR GAS (STREPTOCOCCUS PYOGENES) IS A HUMAN PATHOGEN CAUSING 700 MILLION CASES OF PHARYNGITIS (Ã¢Â‚¬ËŒSTREP THROATÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢) ANNUALLY WORLDWIDE WHILE CDC ESTIMATES APPROXIMATELY 11,000 TO 13,000 CASES OF INVASIVE GAS DISEASE OCCUR EACH YEAR IN THE UNITED STATES ALONE FROM WHICH, BETWEEN 1,100 AND 1,600 PEOPLE DIE. OVERALL, Ã¢Â‚¬ËŒSTREP THROATÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢ IS HIGHLY PREVALENT IN SCHOOL-AGE CHILDREN AND A SIGNIFICANT SOURCE OF ANTIBIOTIC PRESCRIPTION WORLDWIDE, DRIVING SELECTIVE PRESSURE FOR RESISTANCE THROUGHOUT THE HUMAN MICROFLORA. FURTHERMORE, GAS IS ALSO RESPONSIBLE FOR POST-INFECTIOUS IMMUNE-MEDIATED RHEUMATIC HEART DISEASE (RHD), A LEADING CAUSE OF MORTALITY IN THE DEVELOPING WORLD. SOME 30 MILLION PEOPLE ARE CURRENTLY AFFECTED BY RHD, WITH OVER 420,000 DEATHS ANNUALLY (60% < AGE 70) AND 11.5 MILLION DISABILITY-ADJUSTED LIFE YEARS LOST. DESPITE THE HIGH GLOBAL DEMAND, THERE IS NO SAFE AND EFFECTIVE VACCINE AGAINST GAS. THE WORLD HEALTH ORGANIZATION, INTERNATIONAL VACCINE INSTITUTE, WELLCOME TRUST, GATES FOUNDATION, AND OTHERS HAVE CONVENED ADVISORIES ON GAS VACCINE DEVELOPMENT TO ADDRESS THESE SIGNIFICANT SCIENTIFIC CHALLENGES AND MEET THIS PARAMOUNT GLOBAL HEALTH NEED. TO ACHIEVE THIS GOAL AND TO GENERATE A SAFE, ECONOMICAL AND EFFECTIVE VACCINE AGAINST GAS INFECTIONS, THE TEAMS AT VAXCYTE AND NIZET LAB (UCSD) ARE COLLABORATING TO UTILIZE THEIR TECHNOLOGICAL EXPERTISE TO DEVELOP A UNIVERSAL CARBOHYDRATE CONJUGATE VACCINE AGAINST GAS THAT ALLEVIATES AN OVERRIDING SAFETY CONCERN RELATED TO RHEUMATIC HEART DISEASE (RHD), A COMPLICATION OF GAS INFECTION AND A SIGNIFICANT CAUSE OF GLOBAL MORTALITY. TO FACILITATE THIS, THE ACADEMIC LABORATORY OF VICTOR NIZET, MD AT UC SAN DIEGO DISCOVERED THE GENETIC BASIS OF THE MOST ABUNDANT, UNIVERSALLY CONSERVED, SPECIES-DEFINING GAS CELL WALL CARBOHYDRATE ANTIGEN, AND A WAY TO MODIFY IT TO ELIMINATE AN EPITOPE THAT IS BELIEVED TO BE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE GENERATION OF CROSS-REACTIVE ANTIBODIES THAT CAN TARGET HUMAN CARDIAC OR BRAIN TISSUE BY KNOCKING OUT THE PATHWAY RESPONSIBLE FOR SYNTHESIS OF THE GLCNAC SIDE CHAIN. THIS PATENTED DISCOVERY PAVE THE WAY FOR USE OF THE MODIFIED Ã¢Â‚¬Å“POLYRHAMNOSEÃ¢Â‚¬Ï¿½ ANTIGEN IN CONJUGATE VACCINE DEVELOPMENT FOR THE WORLD POPULATION, EXECUTED IN A COLLABORATION LEVERAGING THE UNIQUE XPRESSCF+TM PROTEIN EXPRESSION PLATFORM AND CONJUGATION TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPED BY VAXCYTE, A BIOTECHNOLOGY AND VACCINE COMPANY IN FOSTER CITY, CA, WHO OWNS AN EXCLUSIVE LICENSE FOR THE USE OF THE POLYRHAMNOSE CARBOHYDRATE THROUGH UC SAN DIEGO. MANY CONSERVED SURFACE OR SECRETED VIRULENCE FACTORS INCLUDING C5A PEPTIDASE, SERINE PROTEASE SPYCEP, CYSTEINE PROTEASE SPEB, STREPTOLYSIN O (SLO), ARGININE DEIMINASE (ADI), PILUS ANTIGEN, FIBRONECTIN BINDING PROTEIN, HAVE SHOWN PROMISING RESULTS IN PRECLINICAL ANIMAL MODELS. MANY OF THE TARGETS WHICH ARE BEING INVESTIGATED HAVE YIELDS IN CONVENTIONAL SYSTEMS OF LESS THAN 10MG/L, WHICH IS NOT SUFFICIENT FOR A VACCINE. IN THE VAXCYTE SYSTEM, YIELDS OF THESE CANDIDATE ANTIGENS BETWEEN 10X-50X LITERATURE REPORTED YIELDS, CONFERRING A SIGNIFICANT ADVANTAGE TO OUR JOINT DEVELOPMENT EFFORT. THE KEY DIFFERENTIATING FACTORS OF THE VAXCYTE/UCSD PROGRAM ARE 1) POLYSACCHARIDE CONJUGATE ANTIGENS CONTAINING ONLY THE POLY-RHAMNOSE AND NOT GLCNAC, 2) SITE-SPECIFIC CONJUGATION OF THESE POLYSACCHARIDES TO AN IMMUNOGENIC PROTEIN CARRIER, AND 3) GENERATION OF CROSS-LINKED POLYSACCHARIDE-CONJUGATES. FURTHERMORE, THE YIELD OF PROTEINS INCLUDED IN THE VACCINE IS SIGNIFICANTLY HIGHER IN THE VAXCYTE SYSTEM, DECREASING THE COST OF GOODS ON THE FINAL VACCINE THAT IS IMPORTANT FOR A VACCINE THAT HAS SUCH A POTENTIAL IMPACT ON MORBIDITY AND MORTALITY IN THE DEVELOPING WORLD. THUS, UTILIZING THE TECHNOLOGY AND THE UNIQUE CAPABILITIES OF THIS COLLABORATION, A PRECISELY CHARACTERIZED AND CONSISTENTLY PRODUCED FIRST-IN-CLASS SAFE AND BROADLY PROTECTIVE VACCINE AGAINST GAS INFECTIONS CAN BE SUCCESSFULLY PRODUCED AT INDUSTRIAL SCALE FOR USE IN HUMAN POPULATIONS WORLDWIDE.

description: INFECTION IS A PROGRESSION, BEST STOPPED EARLY. DANGEROUS MICROBES REACH VULNERABLE TISSUES BY PASSING THROUGH “GATEWAYS”, SUCH AS SURGICAL & TRAUMATIC WOUNDS, THROAT & UPPER AIRWAY, AND URINARY TRACT. A FOCAL INFECTION, LIKE A SURGICAL SITE INFECTION OCCURS, AND CAN LEAD TO SEPSIS. WORLDWIDE, SEPSIS IS RESPONSIBLE FOR 1/5 OF DEATHS, WHICH IS OVER 30,000 PER DAY. IN THE US, SEPSIS IS A LEADING CAUSE OF HOSPITAL-BASED DEATHS (1 EVERY 90 SECONDS) AND RESPONSIBLE FOR OVER $50 BILLION IN HEALTHCARE COSTS. FURTHER, 1 IN 2 OF THOSE WHO SURVIVE SEPSIS HAVE SIGNIFICANT LONG-TERM HEALTH COMPLICATIONS, WHICH OFTEN REQUIRE ADDITIONAL HOSPITAL ADMISSIONS AND SUPPORTIVE CARE AT HOME. AMICIDIN-SS IS PURPOSE-BUILT FOR TOPICAL APPLICATION TO CONTAMINATED, COLONIZED, AND INFECTED TISSUES AND IMPLANTS. ALONE, OR AS A COMPLEMENT TO SYSTEMIC ANTIBIOTICS, AMICIDIN-SS SHOULD HELP CLEANSE TISSUES, REDUCE MICROBIAL BURDEN, AND STOP INFECTIONS BEFORE THEY BECOME LIFE-THREATENING. AMICIDIN-SS IS A LARGE MOLECULE BIOLOGIC MADE FROM JUST TWO AMINO ACIDS (MW 12.5-16.5 KDA) AND ITS ENGINEERED ARCHITECTURE IMPARTS A DUAL MODE OF ACTION (MOA): SURFACTANT TO CLEANSE AND MICROBICIDE TO KILL. AMICIDIN-SS IS BROADLY ACTIVE AGAINST GRAM-POSITIVE AND GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA, INCLUDING ALL MULTIDRUG-RESISTANT ORGANISMS (MDROS) TESTED TO DATE, AS WELL AS CANDIDA SPP. FURTHER, AMICIDIN-SS’S MOLECULAR SIZE AND ARCHITECTURE PROMOTE LOCAL TISSUE RETENTION FOR ENHANCED EFFECTIVENESS AND LIMIT ABSORPTION OF INTACT MOLECULES INTO THE BLOODSTREAM FOR ENHANCED SYSTEMIC SAFETY. AMICIDIN-SS TOPICAL SOLUTION IS A CLEAR COLLOIDAL SOLUTION OF AMICIDIN-SS IN WATER AT 10 MG/ML CONCENTRATION. IN NONCLINICAL STUDIES, EFFICACY AND SAFETY WERE DEMONSTRATED IN MULTIPLE MODELS IN VITRO AND IN VIVO. FOR THE UPCOMING CLINICAL TRIAL (SEE BELOW) IT IS PROVIDED IN 50 ML PREFILLED SYRINGES THAT ARE TERMINALLY STERILIZED BY AUTOCLAVE. EXCELLENT SHELF STABILITY AND LONG-TERM STERILITY HAVE BEEN DEMONSTRATED. ANTICIPATED CLINICAL STORAGE IS AT ROOM TEMPERATURE. THIS DRUG PRODUCT FORMAT ENABLES EASY APPLICATION TO A VARIETY OF TISSUES, INCLUDING SURGICAL INCISIONS AND TRAUMATIC WOUNDS. RECENTLY, AN IND APPLICATION FOR A PHASE 1 CLINICAL TRIAL WAS FILED WITH THE FDA AND THE SPONSOR, MACRO BIOLOGICS, INC. RECEIVED A “SAFE TO PROCEED” LETTER. AS SUCH AMICIDIN-SS TOPICAL SOLUTION IS NOW EXPECTED TO ENTER ITS FIRST-IN-PATIENT TRIAL, WHICH IS ENTITLED, “A PHASE 1 STUDY TO ASSESS SAFETY AND TOLERABILITY OF AMICIDIN-SS TOPICAL SOLUTION IN ADULT PATIENTS UNDERGOING INTERVENTIONAL MANAGEMENT OF A SURGICAL OR TRAUMATIC WOUND INFECTION”. THE STUDY IS EXPECTED TO INCLUDE 40 ADULT PATIENTS AND OCCUR AT SEVERAL MAJOR HOSPITALS IN THE UNITED STATES. GIVEN FAVORABLE PHASE 1 SAFETY DATA, LATER STAGE CLINICAL STUDIES WILL BE PERFORMED IN THE SAME PATIENT POPULATION. IN ADDITION, PARALLEL DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED TO OCCUR IN PATIENTS UNDERGOING SURGICAL MANAGEMENT OF ORTHOPEDIC HARDWARE-RELATED INFECTION (OHRI), INCLUDING PROSTHETIC JOINT INFECTIONS (PJI) AND INFECTED OSTEOSYNTHESIS SITES (BONE FRACTURES REPAIRED WITH HARDWARE). IF SUCCESSFULLY DEVELOPED, AMICIDIN-SS TOPICAL SOLUTION SHOULD DRAMATICALLY REDUCE THE TREATMENT FAILURE OF SURGICAL AND TRAUMATIC WOUND INFECTIONS. IN ADDITION, IT SHOULD REDUCE THE OVERALL USE OF ANTIBIOTICS, HELP STEM THE RISING TIDE OF ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE, AND SIGNIFICANTLY REDUCE HEALTHCARE COSTS. MOST IMPORTANTLY, AMICIDIN-SS TOPICAL SOLUTION SHOULD SAVE LIVES

description: STUDY OBJECTIVES THE OBJECTIVES OF THIS TASK ORDER ARE TO: 1. PERFORM AN INITIAL PHARMACOKINETIC (PK) ANALYSIS OF MITO-HNK IN MICE. 2. DETERMINE THE CHEMOPREVENTIVE EFFECT OF MITO-HNK IN MOUSE MODELS OF LUNG CANCER. 3. DETERMINE THE EFFECTS OF MITO-HNK TREATMENT ON BIOLOGICAL MARKERS OF CHEMOPREVENTIVE EFFICACY. TASKS THE CONTRACTOR SHALL PERFORM THE FOLLOWING TASKS: TASK 1: DETERMINE THE PHARMACOKINETIC (PK) PROPERTIES OF MITO-HNK IN THE NIH A/J MOUSE STRAIN. description: FIRST-IN-HUMAN PHASE 1 TRIAL FOR TRL1068 (TRL6C AT END OF STUDY). THE CDC ESTIMATES THAT ~75% OF BACTERIAL DRUG RESISTANCE IS DUE TO THE CHANGE IN PHYSIOLOGICAL STATE THAT ACCOMPANIES BIOFILM FORMATION. TRL1068 IS A NATIVE HUMAN MONOCLONAL ANTIBODY THAT BINDS THE DNABII FAMILY OF BACTERIAL PROTEINS IMPLICATED IN MAINTAINING THE STRUCTURE OF BACTERIAL BIOFILMS. THE EPITOPE IS HIGHLY CONSERVED ACROSS BOTH GRAM-POSITIVE AND GRAM-NEGATIVE SPECIES. THE HIGH AFFINITY ANTIBODY EXTRACTS THE SCAFFOLDING PROTEIN FROM THE BIOFILM MATRIX, LEADING TO DISRUPTION OF THE BIOFILM AND REVERSION TO AN ANTIBIOTIC SUSCEPTIBLE PHYSIOLOGICAL STATE. EFFICACY HAS BEEN ESTABLISHED IN A TRANSLATIONAL MOUSE MODEL FOR IMPLANT INFECTIONS: 70% OF MICE TREATED WITH TRL1068 SHOWED NO IMPLANT OR TISSUE BACTERIA (COLONY FORMING UNITS) VERSUS 0% FREE OF INFECTION FOR THE ANTIBIOTIC ALONE GROUP. SIMILAR EFFICACY HAS BEEN SHOWN IN THREE OTHER RODENT MODELS. THE CARB-X BASE STAGE FUNDING SUPPORTED SUCCESSFUL MANUFACTURING OF THE FIRST CLINICAL LOT, INCLUDING BIOANALYTICAL CHARACTERIZATION, STABILITY TESTING AND DISTRIBUTION INTO VIALS, AS WELL AS A 28-DAY GLP TOXICOLOGY STUDY. THESE RESULTS, COMBINED WITH EFFICACY DATA PREVIOUSLY GENERATED UNDER SBIR FUNDING FROM NIAID, PROVIDE THE SUPPORT FOR AN IND FILING, WHICH WE WILL FILE WITH THE FDA IN OCTOBER 2020. THE OPTION STAGE FUNDING WILL SUPPORT A PHASE 1 TRIAL.

description: CURRENT CLINICAL DIAGNOSTICS FOR INFECTIONS, SUCH AS SEPSIS, ARE FUNDAMENTALLY LIMITED BY HAVING TO GROW BACTERIA. DUE TO THIS, IT TAKES 24-72 HOURS TO DETERMINE WHICH ANTIBIOTICS WILL EFFECTIVELY TREAT SEPSIS, AND THE MAJORITY OF TEST SAMPLES FAIL TO YIELD RESULTS. GENOMEKEY IS DEVELOPING A RAPID DIAGNOSTIC FOR SEPSIS BY COMBINING NOVEL BACTERIAL DNA EXTRACTION TECHNIQUES, NEXT GENERATION DNA SEQUENCING AND MACHINE LEARNING DNA INTERPRETATION. WITH THIS, WE SEEK TO DETERMINE THE PRESENCE OF BACTERIA IN A BLOOD SAMPLE, IDENTIFY THE BACTERIAL SPECIES AND DETERMINE ITS ANTIMICROBIAL SUSCEPTIBILITY, ALL WITHIN A MATTER OF HOURS, AT HIGH ACCURACY AND LOW COST. TO DATE, WE HAVE DEMONSTRATED CERTAIN ELEMENTS OF THE DIAGNOSTIC PIPELINE. THROUGH THIS GRANT-FUNDED RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT PHASE, WE WILL DEVELOP ALL REMAINING ASPECTS OF THE BLOOD-TO-ANSWER PROCESSING PIPELINE AND DEMONSTRATE THIS END-TO-END.

THIS WORK WILL BE CONDUCTED IN PARTNERSHIP WITH SERONET (ACADEMIC AND COMMERCIAL SEROLOGY LABORATORIES), INCLUDING THE FNLCR SEROLOGY LABORATORY, SSNCC AND THE SSC, TO DEVELOP AND MAKE AVAILABLE REAGENTS AND STANDARDS TO THE SEROLOGY COMMUNITY ONCE GENERATED AND QUALIFIED.

description: THE OVERALL GOAL OF OUR PROGRAM IS TO INFORM THE RATIONAL DESIGN OF AN EFFECTIVE TB VACCINE BY IDENTIFICATION OF IMMUNE RESPONSES THAT ARE CAPABLE OF CONTROLLING OR ERADICATING MTB. WE WILL ACHIEVE THIS GOAL BY IDENTIFYING AND DISSECTING PROTECTIVE PATHWAYS IN NATURAL AND VACCINE-INDUCED IMMUNITY THROUGH INTEGRATED ANALYSES OF TISSUE-SPECIFIC AND SYSTEMIC IMMUNITY IN MICE, NONHUMAN PRIMATES (NHP), AND HUMANS. THE OVERALL OBJECTIVES OF OUR PROGRAM ARE AS FOLLOWS: OBJECTIVE #1: CHARACTERIZE IMMUNE LANDSCAPES IN THE LUNG AND DRAINING LYMPH NODES ASSOCIATED WITH THE CAPACITY TO ERADICATE OR CONTROL A SUBSEQUENT MTB CHALLENGE. OBJECTIVE #2: DEFINE EARLY IMMUNE EVENTS IN THE LUNG AND DRAINING LYMPH NODES THAT LEAD TO MTB ERADICATION OR CONTAINMENT PRIOR TO OVERT DISEASE. OBJECTIVE #3: ELUCIDATE THE SPATIAL ORGANIZATION OF SUCCESSFUL MTB CONTAINMENT DURING CHRONIC INFECTION. THE TASKS COVERED IN OPTION 3 BUDGET ARE DESIGNED TO AUGMENT THE TASKS PERFORMED THROUGH THE YEAR 3 BASE BUDGET. SPECIFICALLY, UNDER OPTION 3 WE WILL RESTORE 4 ADDITIONAL RHESUS MACAQUES (RM) TO ACTIVITY 2, EXPERIMENT #3. THE STATEMENT OF WORK PROVIDED DETAILS THE TOTAL NUMBER OF RM IN EACH STUDY (INCLUDING THOSE FUNDED BY THE YEAR 3 BASE BUDGET AS WELL AS THE OPTION 3 BUDGET).

description: SPEXIS HAS DISCOVERED A NOVEL CLASS OF ANTIBIOTICS, THE OUTER MEMBRANE PROTEIN TARGETING ANTIBIOTIC (OMPTA) USING ITS PROPRIETARY MACROCYCLE TECHNOLOGY PLATFORM. OMPTAS ARE BACTERICIDAL AND THEIR MODE OF ACTION INVOLVES BINDING TO BOTH LIPOPOLYSACCHARIDE (LPS) AND OUTER MEMBRANE PROTEINS (OM), RESULTING IN HIGH SELECTIVITY TOWARDS THE MOST CRITICAL GRAM-NEGATIVE PATHOGENS. WHILE MUREPAVADIN, THE FIRST ANTIBIOTIC OF THIS CLASS TO REACH THE CLINICAL DEVELOPMENT STAGE, IS SELECTIVE FOR P. AERUGINOSA BY INHIBITING LPTD, THE SECOND GENERATION OF OMPTAS EXHIBIT A BROAD-SPECTRUM ACTIVITY AGAINST GRAM-NEGATIVE ESKAPE PATHOGENS AND TARGETS THE BAM COMPLEX (BAMA). THE THIRD CLASS OF OMPTAS ARE SELECTIVE AGAINST ENTEROBACTERIACEAE BY INTERACTION WITH THE INTERMEMBRANE LPS TRANSPORT PROTEIN A (LPTA). SPEXIS INITIATED THE DEVELOPMENT OF A NOVEL CLASS OF ANTIBIOTICS LPTA-OMPTA BASED ON THE THANATIN SCAFFOLD, AN INSECT ANTIMICROBIAL PEPTIDE. THANATIN ANALOGUES ARE SELECTIVE FOR ENTEROBACTERIACEAE, WHICH CORRELATES WITH HIGH LPTA CONSERVATION WITHIN THIS ORDER. THEY ARE ACTIVE AGAINST CARBAPENEM RESISTANT ENTEROBACTERIACEAE (CRE) AND MDR/XDR/COLISTIN-RESISTANT E. COLI, K. PNEUMONIAE, AND ENTEROBACTER SPP. NO ACTIVITY WAS OBSERVED AGAINST NATURALLY RESISTANT TO ANTIMICROBIAL PEPTIDE BACTERIA (SERRATIA MARCESCENS, PROTEUS SPP.) OR IN SPECIES WHERE LPTA SEQUENCE IS LESS CONSERVED. THE POTENT IN VITRO ACTIVITY TRANSLATED WELL IN VIVO, EITHER IN THE THIGH, PERITONITIS, LUNG, OR URINARY TRACT INFECTION MODELS. PRELIMINARY DMPK AND SAFETY DATA SUGGEST THAT THE BIODISTRIBUTION AND INTERACTION WITH SELECTED RECEPTORS RELATED TO HISTAMINE, CNS, AND BLOOD PRESSURE, CAN BE MODULATED BY MEDICINAL CHEMISTRY. OUR PRIMARY OBJECTIVE DURING LEAD OPTIMIZATION STAGE IS TO GET A BETTER UNDERSTANDING OF THE CLASS OF COMPOUNDS, AND TO PURSUE THE MEDICINAL CHEMISTRY OPTIMIZATION USING THE SAR LEARNINGS TO IMPROVE THE ACTIVITY AND PROPERTIES OF THE LPTA-OMPTAS. OUR SECOND OBJECTIVE IS TO CHARACTERIZE THE SELECTED LEAD CANDIDATES AND TO NOMINATE A CANDIDATE BY END 2023 WITH AN EFFICACY AND SAFETY PROFILE COMPATIBLE WITH DEVELOPMENT. IN ADDITION, THE INVESTIGATION OF THE MODE OF ACTION OF THANATIN WILL BE CONTINUED IN COLLABORATION WITH PROF. ZERBE AT UNIVERSITY OF ZURICH WHO IS PERFORMING BIOCHEMICAL AND BIOSTRUCTURAL STUDIES TO ELUCIDATE THE BINDING MODE OF THANATIN ANALOGUES TO LPTA DERIVED FROM SENSITIVE AND MUTANT STRAINS. THIS SOPHISTICATED NMR APPROACH IS OUTSIDE OF THE SCOPE OF CARB-X. IN PARALLEL, SPEXIS STARTED A MULTI-SPECIES IDENTIFICATION OF MUTATIONS ASSOCIATED WITH RESISTANCE TO ALLOW FOR POTENCY OPTIMIZATION OF THANATIN DERIVATIVES USING A PANEL OF RESISTANT CLONES WITH DEFINED MUTATIONS IDENTIFIED BY WHOLE GENOME SEQUENCING. OUR AIM IS TO COMPLETE LEAD OPTIMIZATION BY END 2023 FOLLOWED BY PRECLINICAL DEVELOPMENT INCLUDING IND-ENABLING TOXICOLOGY STUDIES AND PHASE 1 STUDIES IN MAN. HENCE, LPTA-OMPTA CONSTITUTES A NOVEL CLASS OF ANTIBIOTICS TO TREAT LIFE-THREATENING INFECTIONS CAUSED BY DIFFICULT-TO-TREAT GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA SUCH AS CRE AND POTENTIALLY ADDRESSES A HIGH UNMET MEDICAL NEED.

description: STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS (SA), CAUSES SERIOUS DISEASES INCLUDING BLOOD STREAM INFECTION, SEPSIS, ENDOCARDITIS, SURGICAL SITE INFECTIONS (SSI), AND PNEUMONIA. METHICILLIN RESISTANT SA (MRSA) IS CURRENTLY A LEADING CAUSE OF THESE LIFE THREATENING INFECTIONS WITH LIMITED OPTIONS FOR TREATMENT. FOUR VACCINE AND IMMUNOTHERAPEUTIC APPROACHES TARGETING SA SURFACE ANTIGENS HAVE BEEN TESTED IN EFFICACY TRIALS IN HUMANS AND ALL HAVE FAILED. ONE OF THESE VACCINES (V710) CAUSED MULTI-ORGAN FAILURE IN VACCINATED INDIVIDUALS WHO WERE INFECTED WITH SA LEADING TO TRIAL TERMINATION BY FDA. STUDIES IN ANIMALS HAVE ALSO SHOWN THAT VACCINES TARGETING SURFACE ANTIGENS INCREASE THE RISK OF DEATH FROM SA INFECTION. THIS PROPOSAL, SEEKS TO DEVELOP A NOVEL, ENTIRELY TOXOID VACCINE (IBT-V02) FOR PREVENTION OF MRSA INFECTIONS. IBT-V02 CONSISTS OF FIVE COMPONENTS REPRESENTING TOXOIDS FOR SEVEN SA TOXINS. DUE TO CROSS REACTIVITY, THESE TOXOIDS ELICIT PROTECTIVE RESPONSES TO 12-15 SA TOXINS. EFFICACY OF IBT-V02 COMPONENTS HAS BEEN SHOWN IN VARIOUS MOUSE AND RABBIT MODELS OF INFECTION. THIS IS THE FIRST ENTIRELY NON-SURFACE ANTIGEN BASED VACCINE FOR SA DISEASE. THE STUDIES TO BE PERFORMED UNDER CARB-X SUPPORT WILL COMPLETE THE PRE-CLINICAL DEVELOPMENT OF IBT-V02 AND TRANSITIONS THE PROGRAM TO PHASE I CLINICAL TRIAL. FOLLOWING THIS FUNDING PERIOD IBT INTENDS TO TEST THE VACCINE IN PHASE II AND PHASE III CLINICAL TRIALS FOR PREVENTION OF SSI IN ELECTIVE SURGERIES AND SEEK APPROVAL FOR THIS INDICATION. A TEAM OF EXPERIENCED SCIENTISTS AND PROGRAM MANAGERS AT IBT, AND EMERGENT BIOSOLUTIONS WILL LEAD THE PROGRAM. TWO LEADING RESEARCH LABORATORIES LED BY DR. JEAN C. LEE (BRIGHAM AND WOMEN HOSPITAL) AND DR. BINH DIEP (UCSF) ARE INTIMATELY INVOLVED IN EXECUTION OF ANIMAL STUDIES. THE PROGRAM WILL ALSO HEAVILY COLLABORATE WITH THE NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF ALLERGY AND INFECTIOUS DISEASES (NIAID) PRECLINICAL AND CLINICAL SERVICES PROGRAM.

description: THIS PROGRAM SEEKS TO OPTIMIZE AND DEVELOP A VALIDATED HIT SERIES OF BACTERIAL TRANS-TRANSLATION INHIBITORS INTO A BROAD-SPECTRUM ANTIBIOTIC FOR USE AS A SINGLE DOSE ORAL THERAPY TO TREAT INFECTIONS CAUSED BY MDR NEISSERIA GONORRHOEAE (NG). THE LIMITED NUMBER OF EFFICACIOUS THERAPIES FOR NG INFECTION, THE ACCELERATING EMERGENCE OF MULTI-DRUG RESISTANCE, AND THE LIMITED DEVELOPMENT PIPELINE OF NEW THERAPEUTICS HIGHLIGHT THE DIRE NEED FOR NEW STRATEGIES. BACTERIAL TRANSLATION IS PLAGUED BY TRANSCRIPTION ERRORS, MRNA DAMAGE, AND TRANSLATIONAL FRAMESHIFTS THAT RESULT IN LOSS OF THE STOP CODON AND FORMATION OF A NON-STOP RIBOSOME COMPLEX, PREVENTING RELEASE OF THE PROTEIN PRODUCTS AND INHIBITING FURTHER TRANSLATION. ESTIMATED TO OCCUR > 5 TIMES/RIBOSOME/REPLICATION CYCLE, RESCUE OF NON-STOP RIBOSOME COMPLEXES IS AN ESSENTIAL PROCESS IN BACTERIA. THE PRIMARY SYSTEM FOR NON-STOP RIBOSOME RESCUE IN BACTERIA IS TRANS-TRANSLATION, COMPRISED OF TMRNA AND SMPB WORKING IN CONCERT WITH ELONGATION FACTOR TU (EF-TU) TO RESTORE PROTEIN SYNTHESIS, EJECT THE DAMAGED MRNA, AND TAG THE NASCENT PROTEIN FOR PROTEOLYSIS. GENES ASSOCIATED WITH TRANS-TRANSLATION HAVE BEEN FOUND IN EVERY BACTERIAL GENOME SEQUENCED TO DATE; MUTATIONS IN THESE COMPONENTS AFFECT VIABILITY OR VIRULENCE IN A WIDE VARIETY OF BACTERIA, AND ARE ESSENTIAL IN NG. THE TRANS-TRANSLATION PATHWAY IS NOT FOUND IN ANIMALS, ALLOWING INHIBITORS OF THIS PATHWAY TO EXERT A SPECIFIC EFFECT ON BACTERIA IN THE PRESENCE OF HOST CELLS. IN PRELIMINARY STUDIES, WE IDENTIFIED SMALL MOLECULES THAT INHIBIT TRANS-TRANSLATION, ACTING AS POTENT ANTIMICROBIALS AGAINST A RANGE OF PATHOGENS, INCLUDING NG, WITH A KEY ANALOG INHIBITING >95% OF TESTED MDR NG STRAINS AT LOW CONCENTRATIONS (MIC90 = 0.27 Ã‚ÂΜG/ML). MECHANISTIC STUDIES REVEALED THAT INHIBITION OF TRANS-TRANSLATION OCCURS THROUGH COMPOUND BINDING TO ELONGATION FACTOR TU (AN ESSENTIAL COMPONENT OF PROTEIN SYNTHESIS AND TRANS-TRANSLATION), SELECTIVELY INHIBITING TRANS-TRANSLATION OVER TRANSLATION. PRELIMINARY EVALUATION OF THESE COMPOUNDS DEMONSTRATED RESPONSIVE STRUCTURE-ACTIVITY RELATIONSHIPS (SAR), A CLEAN TOXICITY PROFILE, AND HIGHLY SIGNIFICANT, DOSE-DEPENDENT EFFICACY IN A MURINE MODEL OF UROGENITAL NG INFECTION AFTER A SINGLE ORAL DOSE WITH AN ADVANCED HIT COMPOUND. THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS CARB-X-FUNDED PROGRAM IS TO PROGRESS THESE COMPOUNDS THROUGH HIT-TO-LEAD, LEAD OPTIMIZATION, PRECLINICAL STUDIES, AND PHASE 1 CLINICAL TRIALS. SUBSEQUENT EFFORTS WILL FOCUS ON PHASE 2/3 CLINICAL TRIALS AND SUBMISSION TO REGULATORY AUTHORITIES FOR MARKETING APPROVAL OF THIS NEW CLASS OF ANTIBIOTICS OPERATING THROUGH A FUNDAMENTALLY NEW ANTIBACTERIAL MECHANISM.

description: DAY ZERO DIAGNOSTICS IS DEVELOPING A CULTURE-FREE, SEQUENCING-BASED DIAGNOSTIC THAT IDENTIFIES WITHIN HOURS BOTH THE SPECIES AND THE ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE PROFILE OF A BACTERIAL INFECTION. WE HAVE DEVELOPED AN ULTRA-HIGH ENRICHMENT SAMPLE PREPARATION PROCESS (BLOOD2BACÃ¢Â€ŽÂ¢) THAT CAN EXTRACT BACTERIAL WHOLE GENOME SEQUENCES FROM PATIENT BLOOD SAMPLES EVEN WHEN THERE ARE JUST A HANDFUL OF BACTERIAL CELLS PRESENT IN THE SAMPLE. WE HAVE ALSO DEVELOPED A PROPRIETARY MACHINE LEARNING ALGORITHM (KEYNOMEÃ‚Â®) THAT CAN USE THE DNA SEQUENCES TO IDENTIFY A BACTERIAL PATHOGEN AND PREDICT ITS ANTIBIOTIC SUSCEPTIBILITY PROFILE. KEYNOME IS TRAINED ON A LARGE SCALE DATABASE (MICROHMDBÃ‚Â®) THAT CONTAINS THE WHOLE GENOME SEQUENCES OF BACTERIAL PATHOGENS MATCHED TO THEIR KNOWN ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE PROFILE. OUR APPROACH ALLOWS FOR THE SIMULTANEOUS TESTING OF A VAST NUMBER OF BACTERIAL SPECIES AND KNOWN RESISTANCE MARKERS, ALONG WITH THE ABILITY TO IDENTIFY NOVEL RESISTANCE DETERMINANTS AS THEY EMERGE. WITH DAY ZERO DIAGNOSTICS, PHYSICIANS CAN TREAT PATIENTS WITH THE MOST EFFECTIVE DRUG IN HOURS, AVOIDING THE COMPLICATIONS, COSTS, AND FRUSTRATION ASSOCIATED WITH EMPIRIC THERAPY.

description: PROJECT GOALS AND OBJECTIVES. THE PURPOSE OF THIS CONTRACT IS TO ASSIST CMS WITH COLLECTING, REVIEWING, AND MAKING PUBLICLY AVAILABLE PROVIDER-LEVEL SUPPLEMENTAL PAYMENT DATA SUBMITTED BY STATE MEDICAID AGENCIES TO COMPLY WITH THE SECTION 202 – SUPPLEMENTAL PAYMENT REPORTING REQUIREMENTS OF THE CONSOLIDATED APPROPRIATIONS ACT (CAA). UNDER THIS CONTRACT, AIR WILL WORK WITH CMS TO COLLECT, FORMAT, REVIEW, AND MAKE PUBLIC FEDERAL DATA ON SUPPLEMENTAL PAYMENTS THAT ARE SUBMITTED BY STATES IN ORDER TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS FOUND IN 1903(BB) OF THE ACT. IN ADDITION, AIR WILL ASSIST CMS IN ANALYZING THE PROVIDER-LEVEL DATA TO DETERMINE OPPORTUNITIES FOR ADDITIONAL GUIDANCE, AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF SUCH GUIDANCE, THAT MAY ENHANCE THE INFORMATION COLLECTION AND/OR HELP FACILITATE THE STATE SUBMISSION PROCESS. OUR EFFORTS WILL PROMOTE TRANSPARENCY IN THE SUPPLEMENTAL PAYMENTS THAT STATES MAKE TO PROVIDERS, WILL IMPROVE THE ACCURACY AND COMPLETENESS OF STATE’S SPV SUBMISSIONS, AND WILL PROVIDE ANALYSES THAT HELP INFORM CMCS FINANCIAL OVERSIGHT OF STATE MEDICAID PROGRAMS. description: FORGE THERAPEUTICS IS DEVELOPING A PORTFOLIO OF NOVEL, DIRECT-ACTING, SMALL MOLECULE INHIBITORS OF ESSENTIAL METALLOENZYMES FOUND IN HIGH PRIORITY GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA. FORGEÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S PLATFORM COMPRISES A DEEP KNOWLEDGE OF METALLOENZYMES, BIOINORGANIC AND MEDICINAL CHEMISTRY KNOW-HOW, AND A FOCUSED FRAGMENT LIBRARY OF PROPRIETARY METAL-BINDING PHARMACOPHORES (MBPS) THAT PROVIDE SELECTIVE AND DIVERSE STARTING POINTS FOR NOVEL INHIBITORS. OUR STRATEGY IS TO FOCUS ON ESSENTIAL METALLOENZYMES FOUND BROADLY ACROSS GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA BUT NOT IN HUMANS. IN BRIEF, OUR LEAD TARGET, LPXC, IS A ZINC METALLOENZYME REQUIRED FOR SYNTHESIS OF THE OUTER MEMBRANE OF GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA. PREVIOUS EFFORTS ON INHIBITING LPXC RELIED ON A HYDROXAMIC ACID (HA) MOIETY TO ANCHOR THE INHIBITOR TO THE CATALYTIC ZINC. ALTHOUGH POTENT IN VITRO, HA-BASED CHEMISTRY SUFFERS IN VIVO FROM GLUCURONIDATION, HYDROLYSIS, AND POOR PK. TO DATE, THERE ARE NO APPROVED ANTIBIOTICS TARGETING LPXC. OUR APPROACH IS TO IDENTIFY NOVEL NON-HA MBPS TO SERVE AS BETTER STARTING POINTS FOR INHIBITOR DEVELOPMENT. FORGEÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S GOAL FOR THE FG-LPXC LUNG PROGRAM IS TO DISCOVER AND DEVELOP A NOVEL LPXC INHIBITOR FOR THE TREATMENT OF LUNG INFECTIONS CAUSED BY GRAM-NEGATIVE BACTERIA WITH A FOCUS ON P. AERUGINOSA.

description: PROJECT DESCRIPTION: CEREBROVASCULAR DISEASE (CBVD) CAN BE ATTRIBUTED TO A GROUP OF CONDITIONS THAT AFFECT BLOOD FLOW AND BLOOD VESSELS IN THE BRAIN. ONE CONSEQUENCE OF CBVD IS THE POTENTIAL FOR PROLONGED MILD COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT (MCI; LUCHSINGER ET AL. 2009). MCI CAN BE DEFINED AS A SMALL YET NOTICEABLE DECLINE IN COGNITIVE ABILITIES, INCLUDING THINKING SKILLS OR MEMORY. PEOPLE WHO HAVE MCI MAY BE AT HIGHER RISK OF DEVELOPING ALZHEIMERÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S DISEASE LATER IN LIFE. AMONG THE TREATMENTS PROPOSED TO ADDRESS MCI, INTERACTIVE METRONOME (IM) IS A COMPUTERBASED TREATMENT THAT ENGAGES THE USER TO TIME THEIR BEHAVIORAL RESPONSES TO BE IN SYNC WITH THE AUDITORY AND VISUAL STIMULI PRESENTED BY THE PROGRAM AT A SET BEAT OVER THE COURSE OF THOUSANDS OF REPETITIONS. FEEDBACK IS PROVIDED TO THE PATIENT VISUALLY AND AUDITORILY ON THE MILLISECOND SCALE. THE AVERAGE MILLISECOND DIFFERENCE FROM PERFECT TIMING IS REFERRED TO AS Ã¢Â‚¬Å“MILLISECOND AVERAGE.Ã¢Â‚¬Ï¿½ THE PROGRAM DEVELOPERS POSIT THAT THIS ONGOING PROCESS OF FEEDBACK AND BEHAVIORAL ADJUSTMENT AT THE MILLISECOND SCALE ENGAGES THE NEUROPLASTIC PROCESSES IN THE BRAIN, ULTIMATELY IMPROVING FUNCTIONAL CONNECTIVITY, THEREBY IMPROVING COGNITIVE FUNCTIONING. THIS TREATMENT HAS PREVIOUSLY SHOWN POSITIVE OUTCOMES WITH STROKE PATIENTS (JUNG ET AL., 2019) AND WITH PATIENTS WITH TBI (NELSON ET AL., 2015). BECAUSE CBVD IS PARTICULARLY PREVALENT IN THE AMERICAN INDIAN POPULATION (ZHANG, ET. AL. 2008), A RECENT, 2-ARM RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED TRIAL (N=173) WAS CONDUCTED TO DETERMINE WHETHER IM IMPROVES COGNITIVE FUNCTIONING IN OLDER AMERICAN INDIANS WITH EVIDENCE OF MCI DUE TO CBVD OVER A 15-WEEK TREATMENT COURSE. THE PRESENT SECONDARY STUDY SEEKS TO ADD INFORMATION TO THE PARENT STUDY WITH THE FOLLOWING SPECIFIC AIMS TO: SPECIFIC AIM 1: TEST WHETHER THERE ARE SIGNIFICANT, WITHIN-SUBJECTS, LONGITUDINAL IMPROVEMENTS ON BOTH IM PERFORMANCE (I.E., CHANGE IN MILLISECOND AVERAGE FROM PERFECT ON A STANDARD EXERCISE THAT IS PERFORMED AT THE BEGINNING OF EACH SESSION) AND COGNITIVE FUNCTIONING (I.E., PATTERN COMPARISON PROCESSING SPEED, FLANKER INHIBITORY, DIMENSIONAL CHANGE CARD SORT, LIST SORTING WORKING MEMORY, AND THE WAIS-IV CODING SUBTEST) OVER THE 15-WEEK TREATMENT COURSE. SPECIFIC AIM 2: TEST WHETHER IMPROVEMENTS IN IM PERFORMANCE AND EXPOSURE TO THE IM TREATMENT PREDICTS IMPROVEMENTS IN COGNITIVE FUNCTION OVER THE 15-WEEK TREATMENT COURSE.

description: OPTION 20C WE ARE PROVIDING RNA VACCINES NECESSARY TO SUPPORT STUDIES INTO THE IMMUNOGENIC AND PROTECTIVE POTENTIAL OF THE CAL09 NUCLEOPROTEIN (NP) ANTIGEN DELIVERED BY RNA VACCINATION IN MICE IN MULTIPLE PRIME/BOOST REGIMENS. TIBAÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S CONTRIBUTION WILL BE THE DESIGN, PRODUCTION, INITIAL TESTING, AND FINAL DELIVERY OF SUFFICIENT QUANTITIES OF THE NECESSARY RNA FORMULATIONS FOR ADMINISTRATION TO MICE FOR IN-DEPTH STUDY AT OUR COLLABORATING CIVIC INSTITUTIONS. THE CAL09 NP AMINO ACID SEQUENCE IS ENCODED INTO THE SUBGENOMIC ORF REGIONS OF TIBAÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S VEEV-BASED REPLICON VECTORS AND IMMUNOGENICITY CONFIRMED IN PRELIMINARY STUDIES. RNA WILL BE MANUFACTURED BY IN VITRO TRANSCRIPTION AND ENZYMATIC CAPPING TO GENERATE 5Ã¢Â‚¬Â„¢ M7GPPPNM-CAPPED TRANSCRIPTS. FOR EACH PRODUCTION LOT, BHK CELLS WILL BE TRANSFECTED WITH THE RNAS PRODUCED FROM THESE VECTORS TO TEST FOR TRANSLATION OF EACH ANTIGEN AND CONFIRM EQUIVALENT EXPRESSION EFFICIENCY. EXPRESSION OF EACH ANTIGEN WILL BE MEASURED BY WESTERN BLOT, QUANTIFIED IN PARALLEL WITH A BENCHMARK CONTROL. EACH VALIDATED RNA WILL BE FORMULATED BY MICROFLUIDIC IN-LINE MIXTURE WITH TIBAÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S PROPRIETARY IONIZABLE ALKYL-MODIFIED DENDRIMER DELIVERY MATERIAL, TESTING VARIOUS CONDITIONS AT SMALL SCALE (VARYING N:P RATIO, FLOW RATE) IN ORDER TO OPTIMIZE FOR THE GENERATION OF MONODISPERSE, SPHERICAL LAMELLAR NANOPARTICLES ~100-150 NM IN DIAMETER. PARTICLE QUALITY WILL BE ASSESSED BY DYNAMIC LIGHT SCATTERING, AND RNA ENCAPSULATION EFFICIENCY WILL BE EVALUATED BY RIBOGREENÃ‚Â® DYE EXCLUSION ASSAY. VACCINE LOTS WILL BE PROVIDED AND SHIPPED TO COMPLETE THE INDICATED MOUSE STUDIES, CURRENTLY TARGETING 5 ÃŽÂ¼G DOSES OF RNA. IMMUNOLOGICAL ASSAYS WILL CONFIRM T CELL RESPONSES AGAINST THE CONSTRUCTS DELIVERED BY TIBA BIOTECH. THE STUDY DESIGN OUTLINED BELOW WILL REQUIRE ~2.2 MG IN TOTAL OF VACCINE OVER THE THREE AIMS, WHICH REPRESENTS A MEDIUM-SCALE PRODUCTION RUN. SUFFICIENT OVERAGE WILL BE MANUFACTURED (~1.5X) TO ACCOUNT FOR REASONABLE LOSSES DURING FORMULATION, ANALYTICS, AND VACCINE HANDLING. THE FIRST AIM OF THE PROPOSED STUDY PERIOD IS TO INVESTIGATE THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN VACCINE REGIMEN AND MEMORY T CELL QUANTITY, DISTRIBUTION, PHENOTYPE, AND LONGEVITY. THE VALIDATED CONSTRUCTS PRODUCED AND TESTED AT TIBA BIOTECH AS DESCRIBED ABOVE WILL BE MANUFACTURED TO PROVIDE ~1 MG OF VACCINE MINIMUM. THE SECOND AIM WILL EXAMINE RESIDENCE VERSUS RECIRCULATING LUNG T CELL BIOLOGY WITH A SMALLER GROUP OF MICE, REQUIRING TIBA TO DELIVER ~400 ÃŽÂ¼G OF VACCINE. THE FINAL AIM IS SIMILAR IN DESIGN TO AIM 2, BUT WITH DOUBLE THE COHORT SIZES TO ACCOMMODATE A CHALLENGE EXPERIMENT TO ASSESS THE CAPACITY OF VACCINE-ESTABLISHED CELLULAR IMMUNITY TO CONFER PROTECTION; ~800 ÃŽÂ¼G OF VACCINE WILL BE SUPPLIED. AT LEAST 10% EXTRA VOLUME WILL BE SHIPPED AT EACH TREATMENT TIME TO ACCOUNT FOR HANDLING LOSSES AND TO EASE SYRINGE LOADING. THE TIMELINE OF DELIVERY WILL BE AT THE DIRECTION OF DRS. MASOPUST AND AHMED, AND ALL EFFORTS WILL BE MADE TO MEET SPECIFIED DEADLINES THAT ENSURE PRODUCT FRESHNESS AND EFFICACY IN COORDINATION WITH THE ANIMAL RESEARCH TEAM. UPON REQUEST, ADDITIONAL LOTS OF VACCINE CAN BE PREPARED WITH REASONABLE NOTICE TO ACCOUNT FOR ADDITIONAL STUDIES OR REPEAT INJECTIONS DEEMED NECESSARY BY MUTUAL AGREEMENT OF THE PIS.

description: THE RAPID PATHWAYS PATIENT PREFERENCE STUDY, AIMS TO QUANTIFY PATIENT PREFERENCES FOR BENEFIT-RISK TRADEOFFS ASSOCIATED WITH PERCUTANEOUS REVASCULARIZATION OPTIONS IN INTERMITTENT CLAUDICATION. THIS WORK WILL PROVIDE IMPORTANT DATA TO BETTER UNDERSTAND HOW PATIENTS PERCEIVE THE POSSIBLE RISK OF LATE MORTALITY ASSOCIATED WITH PACLITAXEL-COATED DEVICES. THE STUDY PHASES ARE: (1) IDENTIFYING KEY BENEFITS, RISKS AND TREATMENT FEATURES FOR A DEFINED CLINICAL SCENARIO; (2) DRAFTING, PRETESTING AND FINALIZING A SURVEY INSTRUMENT; (3) OPERATIONALIZING THE DCE SURVEY (EXPERIMENTAL DESIGN, PROGRAMMING FOR WEB-BASED SURVEY); (4) RECRUITMENT; AND (5) ANALYSIS AND REPORTING. THE PATIENT POPULATION IS EXPECTED TO REPRESENT PATIENTS WITH CURRENTLY SYMPTOMATIC OR PREVIOUSLY SYMPTOMATIC INTERMITTENT CLAUDICATION.

description: PEPTILOGICS IS A BIOTECHNOLOGY COMPANY THAT UTILIZES AN INNOVATIVE PLATFORM TO DEVELOP NOVEL PEPTIDE THERAPEUTICS TO ADDRESS UNMET MEDICAL NEEDS. OUR PIPELINE INCLUDES A NOVEL CLASS OF ENGINEERED CATIONIC ANTIBIOTIC PEPTIDES. OUR LEAD CANDIDATE, PLG0206, BASED ON NATURALLY OCCURRING ANTIMICROBIAL PEPTIDES, EXHIBITS BROAD-SPECTRUM ACTIVITY AGAINST CLINICALLY IMPORTANT MDR GRAM-POSITIVE (S. AUREUS, INCLUDING MRSA, AND E. FAECIUM, INCLUDING VRE) AND GRAM-NEGATIVE (P. AERUGINOSA, E. COLI, AND A. BAUMANNII) PATHOGENS. PLG0206 EXHIBITS THE ABILITY TO RAPIDLY ADDRESS BIOFILM PATHOGENS, MAKING IT AN IDEAL CANDIDATE FOR TREATMENT OF BIOFILM-ASSOCIATED INFECTIONS. PLG0206 TARGETS AND DISRUPTS THE BACTERIAL MEMBRANE, CAUSING RAPID BACTERIAL DEATH VIA CELLULAR CHEMICAL IMBALANCE. SINCE BACTERIAL MEMBRANES ARE A CONSERVED EVOLUTIONARY TARGET, THIS MOA APPEARS TO LIMIT THE RISK FOR RESISTANCE COMPARED TO OTHER ANTIBIOTICS. WITH RAPID BACTERICIDAL AND ANTI-BIOFILM ACTIVITY ON CONTACT, PLG0206 IS BEING DEVELOPED FOR THE TREATMENT OF INFECTIONS ASSOCIATED WITH PROSTHETIC JOINTS (PJI) VIA LOCAL ADMINISTRATION IN CONJUNCTION WITH AN IRRIGATION AND DEBRIDEMENT (I&D) PROCEDURE AND STANDARD-OF-CARE ANTIBIOTIC THERAPY. PJI IS A SERIOUS, LIFE-THREATENING INFECTION WITH SIGNIFICANT ECONOMIC BURDEN. PJI TREATMENT REQUIRES HOSPITALIZATION AND ONE OR MORE REPEAT SURGICAL PROCEDURES. MICROORGANISMS THAT CAUSE PJI INCLUDE S. AUREUS, ENTEROCOCCUS SPP., AND AEROBIC GRAM-NEGATIVE BACILLI. A THIRD OF INFECTIONS ARE POLYMICROBIAL AND REQUIRE BROAD SPECTRUM ANTIMICROBIAL THERAPY. CLINICAL PRACTICE GUIDELINES RECOMMEND RETENTION OF THE CURRENT PROSTHESIS IF PATIENTS PRESENT WITH SIGNS OF EARLY INFECTION. HOWEVER, CURRENT PJI TREATMENT HAS A HIGH FAILURE RATE, AND OFTEN REQUIRES ADDITIONAL FOLLOW-ON SURGICAL PROCEDURES, LEADING TO SUBSTANTIAL MORBIDITY AND MORTALITY, WITH A 20% 5-YEAR MORTALITY RISK. CURRENT ANTIBIOTICS ARE POORLY EFFECTIVE IN THE PRESENCE OF BIOFILM AND ROUTINELY FAIL TO ERADICATE PERSISTER PATHOGENS THAT RESIDE WITHIN THE BIOFILM. PJI REMAINS AN UNMET MEDICAL NEED AND REQUIRES A DIFFERENT APPROACH TO THAT CURRENTLY EMPLOYED. PLG0206, THROUGH ITS RAPIDLY ACTING BROAD-SPECTRUM ACTIVITY AGAINST THE PATHOGENS COMMONLY CAUSING PJI, AND IN THE PRESENCE OF BIOFILM, HAS THE POTENTIAL TO ADDRESS THIS UNMET NEED. PLG0206 ADMINISTERED DURING AN I&D PROCEDURE AS AN INTRAOPERATIVE IRRIGATION SOLUTION IS EXPECTED TO BE MORE EFFECTIVE THAN STANDARD ANTIBIOTIC THERAPY ALONE BECAUSE OF THE HIGH LOCAL CONCENTRATIONS THAT CAN BE ACHIEVED AND ITS ABILITY TO RAPIDLY ELIMINATE BIOFILM-ASSOCIATED PATHOGENS WITH DIRECT CONTACT. THE EXPECTED LIMITED SYSTEMIC EXPOSURE WITH LOCAL JOINT IRRIGATION SHOULD ENSURE A GOOD SAFETY PROFILE. SAFETY HAS ALREADY BEEN DOCUMENTED IN MULTIPLE SAFETY AND TOLERABILITY NONCLINICAL ANIMAL STUDIES INCLUDING GLP TOXICOLOGY. IN ADDITION, AN INTRAVENOUS HUMAN PHASE 1 SINGLE ASCENDING DOSE TRIAL IN HEALTHY VOLUNTEERS WAS SUCCESSFULLY COMPLETED. SINCE THEN, PEPTILOGICS HAS SECURED AN Ã¢Â‚¬Å“ALLOWED TO PROCEEDÃ¢Â‚¬Ï¿½ STATUS FROM THE FDA FOLLOWING A SUCCESSFUL IND SUBMISSION. PEPTILOGICS IS CURRENTLY ENROLLING HUMAN SUBJECTS IN A PHASE 1B CLINICAL TRIAL TO ASSESS SAFETY AND TOLERABILITY OF PLG0206 AS A SURGICAL WASH (IRRIGANT) IN THE TREATMENT OF POSTOPERATIVE PERIPROSTHETIC JOINT INFECTION AFTER TOTAL KNEE ARTHROPLASTY (TKA). PLG0206 WILL BE ADMINISTERED AS A LOCAL IRRIGATION SOLUTION IN PJI SURGERY AS AN ADJUNCT THERAPY TO THE STANDARD SURGICAL CARE AND SYSTEMIC ANTIBIOTIC TREATMENT REGIMEN. THE GOAL BEING A SINGLE OPERATIVE, HARDWARE RETENTION, AND A RAPID RETURN TO FULL FUNCTIONAL CAPACITY.

description: DEBIOPHARM IS DEVELOPING DEBIO 1453, A CLINICAL DEVELOPMENT CANDIDATE, BELONGING TO A NEW CLASS OF ANTIBIOTICS, HAVING A NOVEL MECHANISM OF ACTION, AND WITH ACTIVITY AGAINST NEISSERIA GONORRHOEAE, THE CAUSATIVE BACTERIA OF THE SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED DISEASE GONORRHEA. DEBIO 1453 IS A POTENT INHIBITOR OF THE ESSENTIAL FATTY ACID SYNTHESIS ENZYME ENOYL-ACYL CARRIER PROTEIN (ACP) REDUCTASE I (FABI), AN ESSENTIAL ENZYME IN N. GONORRHOEAE. THIS NOVEL MECHANISM OF ACTION FOR A NEW ANTIBIOTIC CLASS WAS VALIDATED BY DEBIOPHARM'S SUCCESSFUL DEVELOPMENT OF AFABICIN WHICH IS SPECIFICALLY ACTIVE AGAINST STAPHYLOCOCCUS FABI. DEBIO 1453 EXERTS ANTIMICROBIAL ACTIVITY BY INHIBITING THE BACTERIAL FATTY ACID (FASII) PATHWAY, WHICH IS ESSENTIAL FOR THE GROWTH OF N. GONORRHOEAE. DEBIO 1453 INHIBITS FABI, WHICH CATALYZES THE FINAL STEP IN FATTY ACID CHAIN ELONGATION BY REDUCING ENOYL-ACP TO ACYL-ACP. THE POTENTIAL BENEFITS OF THIS NOVEL ANTIBIOTIC ARE: • POTENTIAL FOR HIGH EFFICACY: AS EVIDENCED BY BACTERICIDAL ACTIVITY IN VITRO AND DEMONSTRATED EFFICACY IN VIVO. DEBIO 1453 DEMONSTRATED IN VITRO ACTIVITY AGAINST ALL ANTIBIOTIC-RESISTANT PHENOTYPES OF N. GONORRHOEAE, INCLUDING AZITHROMYCIN- AND CEFTRIAXONE-RESISTANT STRAINS. IN VIVO, IN A MURINE VAGINAL GONORRHEA MODEL DEBIO 1453 WAS ACTIVE AGAINST MULTIPLE ISOLATES, INCLUDING THOSE RESISTANT TO THE REMAINING FIRST-LINE ANTIBIOTICS USED FOR THE TREATMENT OF GONORRHEA. • FAVORABLE RESISTANCE PROFILE: NOVEL MODE OF ACTION WITH NO CROSS-RESISTANCE AND A VERY LOW PROPENSITY FOR RESISTANCE DEVELOPMENT. CEFTRIAXONE-RESISTANT N. GONORRHOEAE STRAINS THAT HAVE EMERGED HIGHLIGHT THE UNMET NEED IN GONORRHOEA TREATMENT. • TREATMENT WITH A MORE TARGETED ANTIBIOTIC WILL DISCOURAGE OVERPRESCRIBING OF BROAD-SPECTRUM ANTIBIOTICS AND ENCOURAGE A BETTER STEWARDSHIP OF THE CURRENT ANTIBIOTIC ARMAMENTARIUM IN THE CONTEXT OF THE LIMITED NUMBER OF ANTIBIOTICS IN DEVELOPMENT. • SUITABILITY FOR BOTH INTRAMUSCULAR AND ORAL ADMINISTRATION. AFTER DEMONSTRATING EFFICACY AND SAFETY IN THOROUGH PRE-CLINICAL PROFILING, DEBIO 1453 IS MOVING TO THE CLINICAL STAGE AND ITS FIRST-IN-HUMAN (PHASE 1) CLINICAL TRIAL WILL EVALUATE TOLERABILITY, SAFETY AND PHARMACOKINETICS OF ORALLY ADMINISTERED DEBIO 1453 TO HEALTHY ADULTS, AND AS WELL IDENTIFY AND SUPPORT THE RECOMMENDED DOSE(S) FOR FUTURE PATIENT TRIALS.

description: DIARRHEAL DISEASES ARE A MAJOR CAUSE OF INFANT MORTALITY AND MORBIDITY IN THE DEVELOPING WORLD, WHERE TWO OF THE MAJOR CAUSAL PATHOGENS ARE CAMPYLOBACTER JEJUNI (C. JEJUNI) AND ENTEROTOXIGENIC ESCHERICHIA COLI (ETEC). CURRENTLY, THERE ARE NO LICENSED VACCINES FOR THESE PATHOGENS. ANTIBIOTICS HAVE BEEN THE SOLE TREATMENT OPTION, LEADING TO THE EMERGENCE OF ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE. TO ADDRESS THIS NEED, LUMEN AIMS TO DEVELOP LMN-0403, AN ANTIBIOTIC-FREE, ULTRA-LOW-COST, COLD CHAIN INDEPENDENT, ORALLY DELIVERED, FOOD-GRADE THERAPEUTIC FOR PREVENTION AND TREATMENT OF DIARRHEAL DISEASES BY C. JEJUNI AND ETEC. LUMEN’S BIOLOGIC MANUFACTURING CAPABILITIES UTILIZE A SPIRULINA EXPRESSION SYSTEM TO PRODUCE A WIDE RANGE OF ANTIBODIES. THIS SYSTEM HAS THE POTENTIAL TO CREATE A THERAPEUTIC COSTING SUBSTANTIALLY LESS THAN 1 DOLLAR PER ADULT DOSE DUE TO MINIMAL DOWNSTREAM PROCESSING REQUIREMENTS. THE FINAL PRODUCT WILL CONSIST OF ORALLY DELIVERABLE SPIRULINA BIOMASS CONTAINING A COCKTAIL OF ANTIGEN-BINDING DOMAINS DERIVED FROM CAMELID SINGLE-CHAIN ANTIBODIES (VHHS) WHICH COVER AT LEAST 80% OF CLINICALLY RELEVANT C. JEJUNI AND ETEC STRAINS. THE WORK TO DATE IN DEVELOPING THIS PRODUCT UTILIZED BIOINFORMATICS TO IDENTIFY A MINIMAL SET OF TARGET VIRULENCE FACTORS; IDENTIFIED A SET OF VHHS THAT NEUTRALIZE THESE VIRULENCE FACTORS; OPTIMIZED THE VHHS BY LABORATORY SCALE EVOLUTION FOR BREADTH OF CROSS REACTIVITY TO REAL WORLD PATHOGEN VARIATION, FOR NEUTRALIZING POTENCY, FOR RESISTANCE TO GASTROINTESTINAL (GI) PROTEASES, AND FOR EXPRESSIVITY; CONSTRUCTED SPIRULINA STRAINS EXPRESSING THIS VHH COCKTAIL. IN THE PROPOSED WORK, THE PRODUCT WILL BE POSITIONED FOR EVALUATION IN A FIRST-IN-HUMAN (FIH) CLINICAL TRIAL. WE WILL ASSESS THE INCIDENCE OF DIARRHEAL DISEASE AND THE PATHOGEN VARIABILITY ENCOUNTERED BY THE POPULATION IN WHICH THE PRODUCT WILL BE CLINICALLY TESTED, TO ENSURE THAT THE CLINICAL STUDY IS ADEQUATELY POWERED AND THE VHH COCKTAIL IS SUITED FOR THIS STUDY POPULATION. WE WILL COMPLETE THE PRECLINICAL STUDIES TO ENABLE REGULATORY APPROVAL, MANUFACTURE CLINICAL TRIAL MATERIAL, AND OBTAIN REGULATORY APPROVAL FOR THE FIH STUDY.

description: THE OBJECTIVE IS TO ADDRESS UNMET NEEDS IN SARS-COV-2 SEROLOGICAL TESTING: 1) STANDARDIZATION, 2) ASSAY DEVELOPMENT, AND 3) AVAILABILITY OF LARGE-SCALE TESTING TO IDENTIFY THOSE WHO MAY HAVE BEEN INFECTED OR EXPOSED TO THE VIRUS. SCALING UP OF VALIDATED SARS-COV-2 SEROLOGICAL ASSAYS WITH EMERGENCY USE AUTHORIZATION (EUA) WITH EVIDENCE OF HIGH SPECIFICITY, SENSITIVITY AND REPRODUCIBILITY, WILL INCREASE NOT ONLY THE NATIONAL TESTING CAPACITY, BUT ALSO ENABLE COMPARISONS OF DATA ACROSS DIFFERENT SITES AND STUDIES. THEREFORE, IT WILL FACILITATE AN UNDERSTANDING OF NATURAL HISTORY OF THE SARS-COV-2 INFECTION, VACCINE DEVELOPMENT, AND IMPLEMENTATION OF NEW VACCINE CANDIDATES. THIS WORK WILL BE CONDUCTED IN PARTNERSHIP WITH SERONET (ACADEMIC AND COMMERCIAL SEROLOGY LABORATORIES), INCLUDING THE FNLCR SEROLOGY LABORATORY, SSNCC AND THE SSC, TO DEVELOP AND MAKE AVAILABLE REAGENTS AND STANDARDS TO THE SEROLOGY COMMUNITY ONCE GENERATED AND QUALIFIED.

description: UNIVERSITY OF MARYLAND SCHOOL OF MEDICINE THE SPECIFIC AIMS OF THE PROPOSED RESEARCH ARE AS FOLLOWS. 1) TO DETERMINE THE PREVALENCE AND ASSOCIATED RISK FACTORS FOR ASYMPTOMATIC INTESTINAL CRE COLONIZATION ON ADMISSION AND INCIDENCE OF INTESTINAL AND NON-INTESTINAL CRE ACQUISITION DURING ICU STAY AMONG PATIENTS ADMITTED TO MEDICAL AND SURGICAL ICUS. DELIVERABLES: WE WILL DETERMINE BASELINE ADMISSION CRE PREVALENCE AND CRE ACQUISITION RATES IN THE ICUS IN THE STUDY HOSPITAL USING SCS. IN ADDITION, RISK FACTORS ASSOCIATED WITH CRE COLONIZATION ON ADMISSION AND CRE ACQUISITION DURING ICU STAY WILL BE DETERMINED. CRE PREVALENCE DETECTED BY ROUTINE CLINICAL CARE VERSUS SURVEILLANCE CULTURES WILL ALSO BE DETERMINED. 2) TO DETERMINE THE OPTIMAL LCS STRATEGY UTILIZING BASELINE PHASE DATA FROM AIM 1. DELIVERABLES: WE WILL DETERMINE HOW ADMISSION AND DISCHARGE CRE RATE RATIOS IN THE ICUS COMPARE WITH SCS VERSUS LCS BASED ON VARIOUS DAYS OF THE WEEK IN THE TWO ICUS, AND WHETHER CLINICAL RISK FACTOR AND CLINICAL CULTURE INFORMATION COULD AUGMENT THE LCS STRATEGY. 3) TO DETERMINE THE IMPACT OF AN INFECTION PREVENTION INTERVENTION(S) ON INTESTINAL CRE COLONIZATION PREVALENCE AT DISCHARGE USING LCS STRATEGY. DELIVERABLES: WE WILL COMPARE THE CRE INCIDENCE RATE RATIOS BEFORE AND AFTER THE INTERVENTION TO DETERMINE THE FEASIBILITY OF LCS STRATEGY TO GUIDE INFECTION PREVENTION MEASURES. DR. SURBHI LEEKHA WILL WORK CLOSELY WITH DR. GANDRA IN PROVIDING SCIENTIFIC INPUT INTO THE DESIGN AND CONDUCT OF ALL ASPECTS OF THIS PROPOSAL. SHE WILL PARTICIPATE IN THE START-UP MEETING, REGULAR COMMUNICATIONS WITH THE STUDY TEAM AND CDC, PROTOCOL DEVELOPMENT, DATA COLLECTION, AND DATA ANALYSIS. SHE WILL ALSO TRAVEL TO THE STUDY HOSPITAL IN INDIA TWICE DURING THE STUDY ALONG WITH WASHU TEAM. THE TRAVEL TO INDIA WILL DEPEND ON THE PANDEMIC SITUATION AND UNIVERSITY AND CDC GUIDELINES FOR TRAVEL.

description: BACTERIAL BIOFILMS HAVE BEEN ESTIMATED TO BE INVOLVED IN 60-80% OF BACTERIAL INFECTIONS. CLARAMETYX BIOSCIENCES, INC. IS DEVELOPING CMTX-101, AN ANTI-DNABII MONOCLONAL ANTIBODY (MAB) THAT RAPIDLY COLLAPSES BACTERIAL BIOFILMS. UNLIKE MOST OTHER ANTI-BIOFILM THERAPEUTICS IN DEVELOPMENT, ANTI-DNABII ANTIBODIES ACT ON BIOFILMS FORMED BY MULTIPLE BACTERIAL PATHOGENS, INCLUDING ALL ESKAPEE PATHOGENS AND ON POLYMICROBIAL BIOFILMS. OUR ANTI-DNABII MAB, CMTX-101, IS RATIONALLY DESIGNED TO TARGET AN IMMUNOPROTECTED REGION OF DNABII PROTEINS AND WILL BE USED IN EMPIRIC THERAPY TOGETHER WITH ANTIBIOTIC STANDARD OF CARE TO TREAT BIOFILM-MEDIATED INFECTIONS. OUR LEAD INDICATION IS TREATING MODERATE TO SEVERE BACTERIAL PNEUMONIA IN HOSPITALIZED PATIENTS. GROUND-BREAKING RESEARCH BY OUR SCIENTIFIC FOUNDERS HAS SHOWN THAT RAPID BIOFILM COLLAPSE ENABLES MORE EFFECTIVE BACTERIAL CLEARANCE BY SEVERAL DIFFERENT MODES OF ACTION.

description: PHICO THERAPEUTICS HAS DEVELOPED A NOVEL TECHNOLOGY CALLED SASPJECT WHICH IS AIMED PRIMARILY AT HELPING TO SOLVE THE PROBLEM OF ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE AND TO PROVIDE AN ALTERNATIVE FOR INFECTIONS WHERE THERE ARE LIMITED TREATMENT OPTIONS. THE TECHNOLOGY COMPRISES BACTERIOPHAGES ENGINEERED TO ACT AS DELIVERY VEHICLES FOR A GENE ENCODING AN UNIVERSAL ANTIBACTERIAL PROTEIN, NAMELY, SMALL ACID-SOLUBLE SPORE PROTEIN, SASP. INSIDE TARGET BACTERIA SASPS BIND TO AND INACTIVATE BACTERIAL DNA IN A NON SEQUENCE-SPECIFIC MANNER MEANING THAT MUTATIONS IN THE DNA DO NOT IMPACT SASP ACTIVITY. THIS MAKES RESISTANCE TO SASP EXTREMELY UNLIKELY TO DEVELOP. THE SASP PROTEIN ITSELF HAS PAN SPECTRUM ACTIVITY WITH EACH PHAGE PROVIDING EXQUISITE SPECIFICITY FOR THE TARGET PATHOGEN. THIS MEANS THAT SASPJECT IS A TRUE PLATFORM TECHNOLOGY THAT COULD BE APPLIED TO ALL BACTERIA. THE TECHNOLOGY HAS NOW BEEN DEMONSTRATED IN STAPHYLOCOCCUS AUREUS, ESCHERICHIA COLI, KLEBSIELLA PNEUMONIAE AND PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA. THIS PROJECT IS AIMED AT COMPLETING PHICOÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S ROBUST PRE-CLINICAL PACKAGE TO SUPPORT FIRST IN MAN PHASE I CLINICAL STUDIES WITH PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA TARGETED SASPJECT PT3.9. THE INITIAL CLINICAL FOCUS IS PATIENTS WHO HAVE VENTILATED HOSPITAL-ACQUIRED PNEUMONIA (VHAP) OR VENTILATOR ASSOCIATED PNEUMONIA (VAP), DUE TO, OR SUSPECTED DUE TO, P. AERUGINOSA, WHERE TREATMENT OPTIONS ARE LIMITED OR HAVE FAILED. P. AERUGINOSA IS FREQUENTLY DIFFICULT TO TREAT AND THESE INFECTIONS CAN HAVE A HIGH MORTALITY RATE. THE PRIMARY FOCUS OF THE PHASE I IS ESTABLISHING SAFETY AND PHARMACOKINETICS IN HEALTHY VOLUNTEERS AND PATIENTS. THE PRE-CLINICAL WORK PROGRAMME COMPRISES: Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ A ROBUST PHARMACOKINETIC-PHARMACODYNAMIC PROGRAMME DESIGNED TO SUPPORT PT3.9 DOSE SELECTION AND OPTIMIZATION Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ REGULATORY ADVICE TO SUPPORT PROPOSED CLINICAL PROGRAMME AND COMPLETION OF A FEASIBILITY ASSESSMENT Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ COMPLETION OF A PRE-CLINICAL MICROBIOLOGY PACKAGE Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ A GLP PRE-CLINICAL SAFETY STUDY DESIGNED TO SUPPORT ENTRY INTO HUMAN CLINICAL STUDIES Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ CMC MANUFACTURE OF A CLINICAL BATCH OF PT3.9 UTILISING PHICOÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S CURRENT ROBUST MANUFACTURING PROCESS Ã¢Â‚¬Â¢ DEVELOPMENT OF AN IMMUNOGENICITY ASSAY TO ASSESS ANY POTENTIAL IMMUNE REACTION TO PT3.9.

description: OPTION 15A (0258-A458-4609) USING MONOCLONAL ANTIBODIES GENERATED FROM THE PHASE I CLINICAL TRIAL OF THE CHIMERIC HA VACCINE, WE WILL DETERMINE ANTIBODY SPECIFICITY, BINDING BREADTH, FUNCTION, AND ABILITY TO PROVIDE PROTECTION AGAINST DIVERGENT INFLUENZA VIRUSES. THIS STUDY WILL INFORM WHICH VIRAL EPITOPES ARE PROTECTIVE OR NON-PROTECTIVE, WHICH WILL DIRECTLY INFORM NEXT-GENERATION VACCINE DESIGN AGAINST INFLUENZA VIRUSES. OPTION 17F (0258-A470-4609) IN THIS SUBCONTRACT, WE WILL DEFINE THE CELLULAR LANDSCAPE AND SPECIFICITIES OF CELLS IN THE NASAL ASSOCIATED LYMPHOID TISSUE (NALT). NALT IS A POORLY DEFINED SECONDARY LYMPHOID TISSUE THAT IS THOUGHT TO BE CRITICAL FOR INITIATING IMMUNE RESPONSES AGAINST RESPIRATORY PATHOGENS. USING NALT TISSUE ACQUIRED FROM SINUSOIDAL SURGERIES AND TONSILS, WE WILL (1) DETERMINE THE CELLULAR COMPOSITION AND B CELL SUBSETS WITHIN THE NASOPHARYNX AND (2) INVESTIGATE THE HA AND NA B CELL SPECIFICITIES WITHIN THE NASOPHARYNX. FOR AIM 1, WE WILL USE SPECTRAL FLOW CYTOMETRY TO ANALYZE THE CELLULAR POPULATIONS WITHIN NALT AND TONSILS. FOR AIM 2, WE WILL ISOLATE HA AND NA SPECIFIC B CELLS AS WELL AS SARS-COV-2 REACTIVE B CELLS AND PERFORM PAIRED SINGLE-CELL RNA-SEQUENCING AND REPERTOIRE SEQUENCING THAT IS LINKED TO ANTIGEN-SPECIFICITY AND SURFACE PROTEIN EXPRESSION. TOGETHER, THE RESULTS OF THIS STUDY WILL REVEAL CRITICAL INSIGHT INTO THE IMMUNE CELL POPULATIONS AND B CELL SPECIFICITIES WITHIN THE NASOPHARYNX. OPTION 17G (0258-A484-4609) IN THIS SUBCONTRACT, WE WILL DEFINE THE CELLULAR LANDSCAPE AND SPECIFICITIES OF CELLS IN THE NASAL ASSOCIATED LYMPHOID TISSUE (NALT) AND MUCOSAL ASSOCIATED LYMPHOID TISSUE (MALT) OF THE OROPHARYNX. NALT IS A POORLY DEFINED SECONDARY LYMPHOID TISSUE THAT IS THOUGHT TO BE CRITICAL FOR INITIATING IMMUNE RESPONSES AGAINST RESPIRATORY PATHOGENS. USING NALT AND MALT ACQUIRED FROM SINUSOIDAL SURGERIES AND OROPHARYNX SURGERIES, WE WILL (1) DETERMINE THE IMMUNE CELL COMPOSITION AND STRUCTURE WITHING THESE TISSUES AND (2) INVESTIGATE THE HA AND NA B CELL SPECIFICITIES WITHIN THE NASOPHARYNX. FOR AIM 1, WE WILL USE SCRNA-SEQ AND SPATIAL TRANSCRIPTOMICS. FOR AIM 2, WE WILL ISOLATE IDENTIFY HA AND NA SPECIFIC B CELLS USING SINGLE CELL CULTURES. TOGETHER, THE RESULTS OF THIS STUDY WILL REVEAL CRITICAL INSIGHT INTO THE IMMUNE CELL POPULATIONS AND B CELL SPECIFICITIES WITHIN THE NASOPHARYNX AND OROPHARYNX.

description: THE SUBCONTRACTOR WILL BE TASKED TO SUPPORT ALL ASPECTS OF THE INVITE PROTOCOL. THE INVITE PROTOCOL IS A MULTICENTER STUDY OF COVID-19 VACCINE IMMUNOGENICITY, DURABILITY, AND BREAKTHROUGH SEVERE ACUTE RESPIRATORY SYNDROME CORONAVIRUS-2 (SARS-COV-2) INFECTIONS IN PEOPLE WHO RECEIVE A COVID-19 VACCINE ACCORDING TO THEIR RESPECTIVE COUNTRYÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S NATIONAL VACCINATION GUIDELINES. SUBCONTRACTOR, AS THE KEY IMPLEMENTATION PARTNER IN THE DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO, SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR PROVIDING THE PREPARATION, IMPLEMENTATION AND EXECUTION FOR CLINICAL OPERATION ACTIVITIES ASSOCIATED WITH THIS CLINICAL RESEARCH EFFORT AND WILL BE REQUIRED TO WORK COLLABORATIVELY WITH OTHER PROJECT STAKEHOLDERS SUCH AS BUT LIMITED TO, PARTICIPATING COUNTRIES, STUDY SPONSORS, AND MINISTRIES OF HEALTH TO CONDUCT AND COMPLETE THIS CLINICAL RESEARCH STUDY. THE SCOPE OF WORK INCLUDES, BUT IS NOT LIMITED TO: ADMINISTRATIVE, FINANCIAL, AND HUMAN RESOURCES MANAGEMENT, CLINICAL RESEARCH SITE OPERATIONS, BIOREPOSITORY, AND COLD CHAIN MANAGEMENT FOR BIOSPECIMENS, PROCUREMENT AND LOGISTICS SUPPORT, LABORATORY OPERATIONS, REGULATORY COMPLIANCE, DATA MANAGEMENT AND IT SUPPORT TO SUPPORT THE PALM PROTOCOL ACTIVITIES. THE OVERALL OBJECTIVE OF THE STUDY IS TO CHARACTERIZE IMMUNOGENICITY OF AVAILABLE COVID-19 VACCINES IN THE OVERALL STUDY POPULATION AND IN DEFINED SUBGROUPS AT 2 MONTHS POST COMPLETION OF VACCINE REGIMEN. THE SUBCONTRACT SCOPE FOR TMGÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S SUBCONTRACT 20X127F4 WAS REVISED THROUGH MODIFICATION 03 TO ADDRESS AN INCREASE IN THE TARGET ENROLLMENT TO 1,100 PARTICIPANTS UNDER INVITE PROTOCOL V2.0 ASSUMPTIONS. IN ADDITION, MODIFICATION 03 ADDRESSED COSTS FOR THE PLANNING AND PREPARATION FOR A RANDOMIZED, PLACEBO-CONTROLLED TRIAL OF THE SAFETY AND EFFICACY OF TECOVIRIMAT FOR THE TREATMENT OF PATIENTS WITH MONKEYPOX VIRUS DISEASE, SUCH AS PROTOCOL DEVELOPMENT AND RESEARCH SITE ASSESSMENTS. THE SUBCONTRACT SCOPE FOR TMGÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S SUBCONTRACT 20X127F4 WAS REVISED THROUGH MODIFICATION 04 NOW REFERRED TO AS THE INVITE COVID-19 OBSERVATIONAL VACCINE STUDY TO INCLUDE THE PALM 007 MONKEYPOX TREATMENT RANDOMIZED CLINICAL TRIAL ARE TO EVALUATE THE CLINICAL AND VIROLOGIC EFFICACY, AND SAFETY OF TECOVIRIMAT (TPOXX) IN PATIENTS WITH MONKEYPOX INFECTION. MODIFICATION 05 ADDRESSED INCLUDING TO INCLUDE COST TO SUPPORT PALM 007 MONKEYPOX RCT BUDGET TO INCLUDE (1) ONE MONTH OF STAFFING AND INITIAL MEETING COSTS FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION AT THE CLINICAL SITE IN TUNDA FROM AUGUST 1, 2022 THROUGH AUGUST 30, 2022; AND (2) INCLUDE THE KOLE SITE PREPARATION/RENOVATION COSTS. IN ADDITION, MODIFICATION 06 INCLUDED RE-COSTING PALM 007 MONKEYPOX RCT BUDGET TO (1) INCLUDE PROTOCOL IMPLEMENTATION AT ONE SITE, TUNDA GENERAL HOSPITAL, WITH A TARGET ENROLLMENT OF 200 PARTICIPANTS, INCLUDING SUPPORT REQUIRED FOR THE JYNNEOS SAFETY STUDY; (2) EXTEND POP FOR THE CY23 8/31/2022-8/30/2023 BY EXERCISING OPTION PERIOD ONE FOR THE INVITE AND BIOREPOSITORY BUDGET.

description: AVAILS MEDICAL, INC. IS AN IN VITRO DIAGNOSTICS COMPANY DEDICATED TO PROVIDING SOLUTIONS FOR THE GLOBAL CHALLENGE OF ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE AND HEALTHCARE ASSOCIATED INFECTIONS, BEGINNING WITH THE BACTEREMIA DIAGNOSTICS MARKET. WITH THE CURRENT STANDARD OF CARE AND WIDESPREAD USE OF LEGACY ANTIBIOTIC SUSCEPTIBILITY TESTING (AST) SYSTEMS, DETERMINING THE ANTIBIOTIC SUSCEPTIBILITY PROFILE OF AN ORGANISM CAUSING A BLOOD STREAM INFECTION CAN TAKE SEVERAL DAYS WHICH DELAYS APPROPRIATE TREATMENT AND ULTIMATELY INCREASES MORTALITY RATES. ADDRESSING THIS NEED FOR FASTER AST RESULTS, AVAILS HAS USED ITS ELECTRICAL BIOSENSOR TECHNOLOGY TO DEVELOP AN Ã¢Â‚¬ËŒEASTÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢ SYSTEM WHICH CONSISTS OF AN ELID CONSUMABLE AND AN EAST READER WHICH ARE USED IN CONJUNCTION WITH CUSTOMIZED 96 WELL AST PLATES. THE ELID CONSUMABLE IS COMPOSED OF 96 ELECTRICAL SENSORS INTEGRATED INTO A LID THAT FITS THE 96 WELL AST PLATE WHICH HAS BEEN INOCULATED WITH THE POSITIVE BLOOD CULTURE SAMPLE (OR BACTERIAL COLONIES IN SUSPENSION). EAST PROVIDES A RAPID PLATFORM ABLE TO MONITOR BACTERIAL METABOLITE PRODUCTION IN REAL-TIME TO ACCURATELY IDENTIFY THE MINIMAL INHIBITORY CONCENTRATIONS (MIC) AND THE MOST EFFECTIVE ANTIBIOTICS. THIS AWARD WILL BE USED TO FUND THE RESEARCH AND FEASIBILITY TESTING REQUIRED TO EXPAND THE NUMBER OF ORGANISMS AND ANTIBIOTICS SUPPORTED BY EAST, ALONG WITH STUDIES DESIGNED TO TEST THE REPRODUCIBILITY OF RESULTS AND TO CHALLENGE THE SYSTEM. THE AWARD WILL ALSO SUPPORT THE CONTINUING DESIGN AND IMPROVEMENT OF THE ELID CONSUMABLE AND THE SINGLE SLOT READER, FOCUSSING ON ALGORITHM IMPLEMENTATION AND SOFTWARE INTEGRATION. FOLLOWING THIS STAGE, THE FUNDS WILL BE USED IN THE DESIGN AND BUILD OF A PROTOTYPE 10 SLOT READER EQUIPPED WITH LIS CONNECTIVITY. THE PROJECT WILL CULMINATE IN AN EXTERNAL PERFORMANCE EVALUATION STUDY, WHERE CLINICAL SAMPLES WILL BE TESTED IN A CLINICAL LABORATORY USING THE AVAILS EAST SYSTEM.

description: OPTION 27A STUDY OBJECTIVES AND SPECIFIC AIMS: CRYO- AND NEGATIVE STAIN ELECTRON MICROSCOPY POLYCLONAL EPITOPE MAPPING (EMPEM) IS AN IMPORTANT NEW TECHNIQUE PIONEERED BY DR. ANDREW WARD (SEM-CIVIC INVESTIGATOR). NSEMPEM IS GREATLY EXPANDING OUR ABILITY TO UNDERSTAND THE POLYCLONAL RESPONSES AND DEFINE THE POPULATIONS OF ANTIBODIES TARGETING DIFFERENT EPITOPES INDUCED BY VACCINATION. TO PERFORM NSEMPEM, SAMPLES ARE PREPARED BY PURIFYING IGG ANTIBODIES FROM SERA, DIGESTING THE PURIFIED IGG ANTIBODIES INTO FABS WITH PAPAIN, AND COMPLEXING FABS WITH THE ANTIGEN. THE FAB-ANTIGEN COMPLEXES ARE IMAGED BY NEGATIVE STAIN ELECTRON MICROSCOPY. SINGLE PARTICLE EM DATA IS ANALYZED IN SOFTWARE PACKAGES TO PICK PARTICLES, PERFORM 2D CLASSIFICATION OF FAB POPULATIONS BY THE EPITOPE THEY TARGET, AND OBTAIN 3D RECONSTRUCTIONS OF FAB-ANTIGEN COMPLEXES. OUR LAB RECENTLY DEVELOPED AN AUTOMATED PIPELINE, Ã¢Â‚¬Å“CLOAKING WITH GLYCANSÃ¢Â‚¬Ï¿½ (CWG), TO SCREEN ALL RESIDUES FOR PNGS SEQUONS ON GLYCOPROTEINS. THIS PIPELINE USES ROSETTA, A PROTEIN DESIGN SOFTWARE. TO MODEL THE AMINO ACID MUTATIONS OF THE PNGS SEQUON AND THE ADDITION OF A GLYCAN TREE. ROSETTA SCORES FOR SOLVENT ACCESSIBLE SURFACE AREA OF RESIDUE BEING MUTATED TO ASPARAGINE, CLASHING INTRODUCED BY THE INTRODUCTION OF THE SEQUON, AND CLASHING OF THE GLYCAN WITH THE STRUCTURE ARE CALCULATED. CUTOFFS DETERMINED USING THE SCORES OF NATIVE NLINKED GLYCANS ON A PANEL OF VIRAL GLYCOPROTEINS ARE USED TO SELECT PNGS MODIFICATIONS TO SCREEN IN VITRO. THE CWG PIPELINE IS THE FIRST ROBUST, AUTOMATED METHOD FOR SCREENING FOR PNGS. WE ARE INTERESTED IN EXPLORING HOW ANTIBODY SPECIFICITY CAN BE ALTERED BY INCORPORATION OF PNGS INTO INFLUENZA GLYCOPROTEINS. NSEMPEM WILL AFFORD THE ABILITY TO UNDERSTAND THE SHIFT IN THE POPULATION DISTRIBUTION OF VACCINE-INDUCED ANTIBODIES TOWARDS SPECIFIC EPITOPES AND INFORM AN ITERATIVE IMPROVEMENT OF IMMUNE FOCUSING TO SELECT EPITOPES IN WAYS WHICH OTHER ASSAYS ARE LIMITED. HERE, WE PROPOSE TO CONTRAST THE IMMUNODOMINANCE PATTERNS OF THE SERA FROM MICE IMMUNIZED WITH THE WT AND IMMUNE FOCUSED A/H1N1/NEW CALEDONIA/20/1999 NANOPARTICLE CONSTRUCTS THAT WE HAVE DEVELOPED TO DEFINE THE PATTERN OF TARGETED EPITOPES AND TO REFINE OUR CWG METHOD. TO ENSURE SUFFICIENT SERA, WE WILL POOL THE TERMINAL BLEED TIMEPOINT SERA THE MICE IN EACH GROUP (WT AND IMMUNE FOCUSED), PURIFY IGG ANTIBODIES USING A PROTEIN G COLUMN, DIGEST IGG INTO FABS USING PAPAIN DIGESTION KITS, COUPLE FABS TO NC99 HA TRIMERS, AND PURIFY COMPLEXES BY SIZE EXCLUSION CHROMATOGRAPHY. COMPLEXES WILL BE ADSORBED ONTO GLOW DISCHARGED CARBON-COATED COPPER EM GRIDS, STAINED WITH URANYL ACETATE, AND IMAGED WITH A FEI TECNAI T12 MICROSCOPE EQUIPPED WITH ONEVIEW GATAN CAMERA. WE WILL THEN BE TRAINED TO PROCESS THE SINGLE PARTICLE ANALYSIS TO BE ABLE TO CLASSIFY ANTIBODIES BY EPITOPES AND PERFORM 2D CLASS AVERAGES OF THESE POPULATIONS, AND PERFORM 3D RECONSTRUCTIONS. WE WILL HARNESS WHAT WE LEARN TO FURTHER DEVELOP OF OUR CWG PLATFORM, SO THE NUMBER AND DENSITY OF GLYCANS INCLUDED IN IMMUNOGENS WILL MORE LIKELY INDUCE THE ANTIBODY SPECIFICITY INTENDED. THESE STUDIES WILL HELP US TO BETTER CHARACTERIZE ANTIBODY SPECIFICITY, IMPROVE IMMUNE FOCUSING EFFORTS FOR INFLUENZA, AND INFORM IMPROVEMENTS ON OUR CWG PIPELINE FOR BROAD APPLICATION TO A RANGE OF VIRAL GLYCOPROTEINS. FIT WITH CURRENT CIVICS PROJECTS: THE CURRENT CIVIC PROGRAM IS FOCUSED ON DEVELOPING ENHANCED SEASONAL OR UNIVERSAL INFLUENZA VACCINES. MANIPULATING ANTIBODY RESPONSES BY IMMUNE FOCUSING CAN RESULT IN HIGHER LEVELS OF FUNCTIONAL, NEUTRALIZING ANTIBODIES AND POTENTIALLY RESULT IN TARGETING OF MORE CONSERVED EPITOPES. EMPEM IS A KEY METHOD USED WITHIN THE SEM-CIVIC TO UNDERSTAND RESPONSES AND WE SEEK TO APPLY EMPEM TO AID FURTHER DEVELOPMENT OF OUR IMMUNE FOCUSED NANOPARTICLE HA VACCINES.

description: PROJECT TITLE: OUTCOMES OF HUMAN ADENOVIRUS (HADV) INFECTION AND DISEASE IN PEDIATRIC ALLOGENEIC STEM CELL TRANSPLANT RECIPIENTS: A PROSPECTIVE MULTICENTER OBSERVATIONAL COHORT START/END DATES: 07/01/2016 TO 06/30/2021 STUDY SITE: LOVELACE BIOMEDICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE (LBERI) STUDY LOCATION: ALBUQUERQUE, NM SITE-PI/STUDY CO-PI NAME: DR. ADRIANA KAJON DR. KAJON WILL SERVE AS THE LBERI SITE-PI AND THE STUDY CO-PI OVERSEEING SPECIMEN SHIPPING FROM CLINICAL SITES AS WELL AS PROCESSING OF ALL RESEARCH-DIRECTED SERUM AND STOOL SPECIMENS, AND SUBSEQUENTLY ALL CLINICAL SPECIMENS POSITIVE FOR ADENOVIRUS BY PCR. DR. KAJON WILL ALSO OVERSEE THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE REDCAPTM DATABASE AND ENSURE THAT THE DATA ARE MAINTAINED IN A MANNER THAT IS COMPLIANT WITH THE NIH REQUIREMENTS FOR THIS CONTRACT. THE DATABASE WILL BE DEVELOPED AND STORED AT LBERI. FINALLY, SHE WILL ASSIST IN PROTOCOL DEVELOPMENT (INCLUDING STUDY DESIGN AND ANALYTIC PLAN), DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF THE MANUAL OF PROCEDURES, AND CONTRIBUTE TO MANUSCRIPT PREPARATION. DATABASE DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE HANS PETERSEN, SENIOR RESEARCH ASSOCIATE, WILL OVERSEE THE DEVELOPMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF THE REDCAPTM DATABASE. THE DATA ELEMENTS TO BE COLLECTED BY THE CLINICAL SITES WILL BE DETERMINED BY CHOP STUDY PERSONNEL AND SEQUENCED TO MR. PETERSEN FOR DATABASE DEVELOPMENT. THE DATABASE WILL BE DEVELOPED AND PILOTED BEFORE IT IS SHARED WITH CLINICAL SITES FOR ACTUAL DATA ENTRY. WHEN POSSIBLE, THE REDCAPTM DATABASE WILL BE DEVELOPED USING CDISC SDTM TERMINOLOGY. THE LBERI STAFF WILL ASSIST IN REGISTERING ALL LOCAL STUDY STAFF AT EACH OF THE PARTICIPATING CLINICAL SITES FOR REDCAPTM ACCESS. ON A PERIODIC BASIS MR. PETERSEN WILL DOWNLOAD THE DATA AND RUN A NUMBER OF AUTOMATED DATA CHECKS. ANY ERRORS OR MISSING DATA FROM THESE CHECKS WILL BE TRANSFERRED BACK TO THE CLINICAL SITE AND UPDATED. PROCESSING OF RESEARCH SPECIMENS AND CLINICAL SPECIMENS POSITIVE FOR ADENOVIRUS DR. KAJON WILL COMMUNICATE WITH EACH LOCAL SITEÃ¢Â‚¬Â„¢S LABORATORY TO ENSURE APPROPRIATE PROCESSING AND SHIPMENT OF STUDY SPECIMENS. ALL TESTING DICTATED BY THE STUDY PROTOCOL WILL BE PERFORMED IN THE LABORATORY OF DR. ADRIANA KAJON. THIS WILL INCLUDE SEROLOGY TESTING FOR ANTI-ADENOVIRUS IGG BY ELISA, PLAQUE REDUCTION ASSAYS TO DETECT TYPE-SPECIFIC NEUTRALIZING ANTIBODIES, VIRAL ISOLATION IN CELL CULTURE FROM STOOL SPECIMENS, MOLECULAR TYPING OF ADENOVIRUS ISOLATES DETECTED IN RESEARCH AND/OR CLINICAL SPECIMENS OF ENROLLED PATIENTS, AND RESISTANCE TESTING OF ADENOVIRUS TO CIDOFOVIR, AND OTHER ANTIVIRAL AGENTS. CONFERENCE CALLS AND STUDY MEETINGS DR. KAJON AND MR. PETERSEN WILL BE EXPECTED TO PARTICIPATE IN MONTHLY CONFERENCE CALLS. ADDITIONALLY, DR. KAJON WILL BE EXPECTED TO PARTICIPATE IN A STUDY KICK-OFF MEETING, AND IN YEARLY IN-PERSON STUDY MEETINGS.
